糖尿病黄斑水肿

阅读、驾驶和看脸所需的视网膜部分称为黄斑。糖尿病会导致黄斑肿胀，称为糖尿病性黄斑水肿。随着时间的推移，这种疾病会破坏眼睛这部分的敏锐视力，导致部分视力丧失或失明。黄斑水肿通常发生在已经出现糖尿病视网膜病变其他症状的人身上。

青光眼

青光眼是一组会损害视神经（连接眼睛和大脑的神经束）的眼部疾病。糖尿病使患青光眼的几率增加一倍，如果不及早治疗，可能会导致视力丧失和失明。

症状取决于您患有哪种类型的青光眼。了解有关青光眼的更多信息。

白内障
chunks.text_en:
stage is called proliferative diabetic retinopathy. These abnormal new blood vessels can lead to serious vision problems.

Diabetic macular edema

The part of your retina that you need for reading, driving, and seeing faces is called the macula . Diabetes can lead to swelling in the macula, which is called diabetic macular edema. Over time, this disease can destroy the sharp vision in this part of the eye, leading to partial vision loss or blindness. Macular edema usually develops in people who already have other signs of diabetic retinopathy.

Glaucoma

Glaucoma is a group of eye diseases that can damage the optic nerve—the bundle of nerves that connects the eye to the brain. Diabetes doubles the chances of having glaucoma, which can lead to vision loss and blindness if not treated early.

Symptoms depend on which type of glaucoma you have. Learn more about glaucoma .

Cataracts

chunks.text_zh:
如果不及早治疗，会导致视力丧失和失明。

症状取决于您患有哪种类型的青光眼。了解有关青光眼的更多信息。

白内障

我们眼睛内的晶状体是透明结构，有助于提供清晰的视力，但随着年龄的增长，它们往往会变得混浊。糖尿病患者更有可能出现晶状体混浊，称为白内障。糖尿病患者比非糖尿病患者更早患白内障。研究人员认为，高葡萄糖水平会导致沉积物在眼睛的晶状体中堆积。

糖尿病眼病有多常见？

大约三分之一的年龄超过 40 岁的糖尿病患者已经出现一些糖尿病视网膜病变的迹象。糖尿病视网膜病变是糖尿病患者视力丧失的最常见原因。然而，每个人对未来的展望在很大程度上取决于定期护理。及早发现并治疗糖尿病视网膜病变可将失明风险降低 95 百分比。

青光眼和白内障

您患青光眼或白内障的几率大约是没有糖尿病的人的两倍。
chunks.text_en:
lead to vision loss and blindness if not treated early.

Symptoms depend on which type of glaucoma you have. Learn more about glaucoma .

Cataracts

The lenses within our eyes are clear structures that help provide sharp vision—but they tend to become cloudy as we age. People with diabetes are more likely to develop cloudy lenses, called cataracts . People with diabetes can develop cataracts at an earlier age than people without diabetes. Researchers think that high glucose levels cause deposits to build up in the lenses of your eyes.

How common is diabetic eye disease?

About one in three people with diabetes who are older than age 40 already have some signs of diabetic retinopathy. Diabetic retinopathy is the most common cause of vision loss in people with diabetes. Each person’s outlook for the future, however, depends in large part on regular care. Finding and treating diabetic retinopathy early can reduce the risk of blindness by 95 percent.

Glaucoma and cataracts

Your chances of developing glaucoma or cataracts are about twice that of someone without diabetes.

chunks.text_zh:
失明率 95 百分比。

青光眼和白内障

您患青光眼或白内障的几率大约是没有糖尿病的人的两倍。

哪些人更容易患糖尿病眼病？

任何患有糖尿病的人都可能患上糖尿病眼病。您的风险更大

未经治疗的高血糖

未经治疗的高血压

高胆固醇和吸烟也可能会增加患糖尿病眼病的风险。

有些群体比其他群体受到的影响更大。非裔美国人、美洲印第安人和阿拉斯加原住民、西班牙裔/拉丁裔、太平洋岛民和老年人因糖尿病而丧失视力或失明的风险更大。

如果您患有糖尿病并怀孕，您在怀孕期间可能会很快出现眼部问题。如果您已经患有一些糖尿病视网膜病变，那么在怀孕期间情况可能会变得更糟。帮助您的身体支持成长中的婴儿的变化可能会给您眼睛的血管带来压力。您的医疗保健团队会建议您在怀孕期间定期进行眼科检查，以便及早发现和治疗问题并保护您的视力。
chunks.text_en:
blindness by 95 percent.

Glaucoma and cataracts

Your chances of developing glaucoma or cataracts are about twice that of someone without diabetes.

Who is more likely to develop diabetic eye disease?

Anyone with diabetes can develop diabetic eye disease. Your risk is greater with

high blood glucose that is not treated

high blood pressure that is not treated

High blood cholesterol and smoking may also raise your risk for diabetic eye disease.

Some groups are affected more than others. African Americans, American Indians and Alaska Natives, Hispanics/Latinos, Pacific Islanders, and older adults are at greater risk of losing vision or going blind from diabetes.

If you have diabetes and become pregnant, you can develop eye problems very quickly during your pregnancy. If you already have some diabetic retinopathy, it can get worse during pregnancy. Changes that help your body support a growing baby may put stress on the blood vessels in your eyes. Your health care team will suggest regular eye exams during pregnancy to catch and treat problems early and protect your vision.

chunks.text_zh:
在你眼里。您的医疗保健团队会建议您在怀孕期间定期进行眼科检查，以便及早发现和治疗问题并保护您的视力。

仅在怀孕期间发生的糖尿病称为妊娠糖尿病，通常不会引起眼睛问题。研究人员不确定为什么会出现这种情况。

患糖尿病的时间越长，患糖尿病眼病的几率就会越高。

糖尿病眼病有哪些症状？

糖尿病眼病的早期症状通常没有。当眼睛内部开始出现损伤时，尤其是患有糖尿病性视网膜病变的患者，您可能不会感到疼痛，视力也不会发生变化。

当症状确实出现时，它们可能包括

视力模糊或波动

视力经常变化——有时每天都在变化

黑暗区域或视力丧失

色觉不佳

斑点或黑线（也称为飞蚊症）

闪光

如果您有任何这些症状，请咨询您的眼科医生。

我什么时候应该立即去看医生？
chunks.text_en:
in your eyes. Your health care team will suggest regular eye exams during pregnancy to catch and treat problems early and protect your vision.

Diabetes that occurs only during pregnancy, called gestational diabetes , does not usually cause eye problems. Researchers aren't sure why this is the case.

Your chances of developing diabetic eye disease increase the longer you have diabetes.

What are the symptoms of diabetic eye disease?

Often there are no early symptoms of diabetic eye disease. You may have no pain and no change in your vision as damage begins to grow inside your eyes, particularly with diabetic retinopathy.

When symptoms do occur, they may include

blurry or wavy vision

frequently changing vision—sometimes from day to day

dark areas or vision loss

poor color vision

spots or dark strings (also called floaters)

flashes of light

Talk with your eye doctor if you have any of these symptoms.

When should I see a doctor right away?

chunks.text_zh:
（也称为飞蚊症）

闪光

如果您有任何这些症状，请咨询您的眼科医生。

我什么时候应该立即去看医生？

如果您发现视力突然变化，包括闪光或比平时更多的斑点（飞蚊症），请立即就医。如果您的眼睛看起来像是被窗帘拉住了，您也应该立即去看医生。这些视力变化可能是视网膜脱离的症状，这是一种医疗紧急情况。

医生如何诊断糖尿病引起的眼部问题？

进行全面的散瞳眼科检查是检查糖尿病引起的眼部问题的最佳方法。您的医生会在您的眼睛中滴眼药水以扩大瞳孔。这使得医生可以使用特殊的放大镜检查每只眼睛后部的更大区域。散瞳检查后几个小时内您的视力会变得模糊。

您的医生也会

测试你的视力

测量眼睛的压力

根据您的健康史，您的医生也可能会建议其他检查。
chunks.text_en:
(also called floaters)

flashes of light

Talk with your eye doctor if you have any of these symptoms.

When should I see a doctor right away?

Call a doctor right away if you notice sudden changes to your vision, including flashes of light or many more spots (floaters) than usual. You also should see a doctor right away if it looks like a curtain is pulled over your eyes. These changes in your sight can be symptoms of a detached retina , which is a medical emergency.

How do doctors diagnose eye problems from diabetes?

Having a full, dilated eye exam is the best way to check for eye problems from diabetes. Your doctor will place drops in your eyes to widen your pupils. This allows the doctor to examine a larger area at the back of each eye, using a special magnifying lens. Your vision will be blurry for a few hours after a dilated exam.

Your doctor will also

test your vision

measure the pressure in your eyes

Your doctor may suggest other tests, too, depending on your health history.

chunks.text_zh:
医生也会

测试你的视力

测量眼睛的压力

根据您的健康史，您的医生也可能会建议其他检查。

大多数糖尿病患者应该每年去看眼科专业人士一次，进行一次全面的眼科检查。您自己的医疗保健团队可能会根据您的糖尿病类型以及自首次诊断以来的时间建议不同的计划。

糖尿病眼科检查指南：

类型 1：每年应在诊断后 5 年内开始眼科检查。

输入 2：诊断后应立即开始年度眼科检查。

怀孕：患有 1 型和 2 型糖尿病的女性在怀孕前或怀孕前 3 个月内需要进行眼科检查。您的医生可能希望您在怀孕后期重复检查，直到您的宝宝 1 岁。

患有妊娠糖尿病的女性通常不需要进行眼科检查，因为她们在怀孕期间不会患上糖尿病眼病。如果您有任何疑问，请咨询您的医生。

医生如何治疗糖尿病眼病？
chunks.text_en:
doctor will also

test your vision

measure the pressure in your eyes

Your doctor may suggest other tests, too, depending on your health history.

Most people with diabetes should see an eye care professional once a year for a complete eye exam. Your own health care team may suggest a different plan, based on your type of diabetes and the time since you were first diagnosed.

Eye exam guidelines for diabetes :

Type 1: Yearly eye exams should start within 5 years of diagnosis.

Type 2: Yearly eye exams should start right after diagnosis.

Pregnancy: Women with type 1 and type 2 diabetes need an eye exam before pregnancy or within the first 3 months. Your doctor may want you to repeat the exam later in your pregnancy and until your baby is 1 year old.

Women who develop gestational diabetes don’t usually need an eye exam because they don’t develop diabetic eye disease during pregnancy. If you have any questions, ask your doctor.

How do doctors treat diabetic eye disease?

chunks.text_zh:
他们在怀孕期间不会患上糖尿病眼病。如果您有任何疑问，请咨询您的医生。

医生如何治疗糖尿病眼病？

您的医生可能会建议每年进行一次以上的眼科检查，同时控制您的糖尿病。这意味着管理您的糖尿病 ABC，其中包括 A1c、血压和胆固醇；并戒烟。询问您的医疗保健团队您可以采取哪些措施来实现您的目标。

医生可能会通过药物、激光治疗、手术或这些方法的组合来治疗晚期眼部问题。

医学

您的医生可能会使用抗 VEGF 药物治疗您的眼睛，例如阿柏西普、贝伐珠单抗或雷珠单抗。这些药物可以阻止眼睛异常血管的生长。抗 VEGF 药物还可以阻止液体渗漏，从而有助于治疗糖尿病性黄斑水肿。
chunks.text_en:
they don’t develop diabetic eye disease during pregnancy. If you have any questions, ask your doctor.

How do doctors treat diabetic eye disease?

Your doctor may recommend having eye exams more often than once a year, along with management of your diabetes. This means managing your diabetes ABCs, which include your A1c, blood pressure, and cholesterol; and quitting smoking. Ask your health care team what you can do to reach your goals.

Doctors may treat advanced eye problems with medicine, laser treatments, surgery, or a combination of these options.

Medicine

Your doctor may treat your eyes with anti-VEGF medicine, such as aflibercept, bevacizumab, or ranibizumab. These medicines block the growth of abnormal blood vessels in the eye. Anti-VEGF medicines can also stop fluid leaks, which can help treat diabetic macular edema .

chunks.text_zh:
阻止眼睛异常血管的生长。抗 VEGF 药物还可以阻止液体渗漏，从而有助于治疗糖尿病性黄斑水肿。

就诊时，医生会向您的眼睛注射抗 VEGF 药物。您将在最初几个月内接受多次治疗，然后在完成第一轮治疗后接受更少的治疗。您的医生会使用药物麻醉您的眼睛，这样您就不会感到疼痛。针的粗细约为人类头发的粗细。

抗 VEGF 治疗可以阻止进一步的视力丧失，并可能改善某些人的视力。

激光治疗

激光治疗也称为光凝术，通过光束在眼睛内造成微小烧伤。这种方法可以治疗渗漏的血管和多余的液体（称为水肿）。您的医生通常会在几次就诊期间提供这种治疗，使用药物麻醉您的眼睛。激光治疗可以防止眼病恶化，这对于防止视力丧失或失明非常重要。但与抗 VEGF 药物相比，激光治疗不太可能恢复已经丧失的视力。
chunks.text_en:
block the growth of abnormal blood vessels in the eye. Anti-VEGF medicines can also stop fluid leaks, which can help treat diabetic macular edema .

The doctor will inject an anti-VEGF medicine into your eyes during office visits. You'll have several treatments during the first few months, then fewer treatments after you finish the first round of therapy. Your doctor will use medicine to numb your eyes so you don’t feel pain. The needle is about the thickness of a human hair.

Anti-VEGF treatments can stop further vision loss and may improve vision in some people.

Laser Treatment

Laser treatment, also called photocoagulation, creates tiny burns inside the eye with a beam of light. This method treats leaky blood vessels and extra fluid, called edema. Your doctor usually provides this treatment during several office visits, using medicine to numb your eyes. Laser treatment can keep eye disease from getting worse, which is important to prevent vision loss or blindness. But laser treatment is less likely to bring back vision you’ve already lost compared with anti-VEGF medicines.

chunks.text_zh:
以防止视力丧失或失明。但与抗 VEGF 药物相比，激光治疗不太可能恢复已经丧失的视力。

激光治疗有两种类型：

焦点/网格激光治疗作用于视网膜的一小块区域，以治疗糖尿病性黄斑水肿。

散射激光治疗，也称为全视网膜光凝术 (PRP)，可覆盖更大的视网膜区域。这种方法可以治疗异常血管的生长，称为增殖性糖尿病视网膜病变。

玻璃体切除术

玻璃体切除术是一种去除填充眼睛中心的透明凝胶（称为玻璃体凝胶）的手术。该手术可治疗由增殖性糖尿病视网膜病变引起的严重出血或疤痕组织问题。疤痕组织会迫使视网膜与其下方的组织剥离，就像壁纸从墙上剥落一样。视网膜完全松动或脱落可能导致失明。
chunks.text_en:
to prevent vision loss or blindness. But laser treatment is less likely to bring back vision you’ve already lost compared with anti-VEGF medicines.

There are two types of laser treatment :

Focal/grid laser treatment works on a small area of the retina to treat diabetic macular edema.

Scatter laser treatment, also called panretinal photocoagulation (PRP), covers a larger area of the retina. This method treats the growth of abnormal blood vessels, called proliferative diabetic retinopathy.

Vitrectomy

Vitrectomy is a surgery to remove the clear gel that fills the center of the eye, called the vitreous gel. The procedure treats problems with severe bleeding or scar tissue caused by proliferative diabetic retinopathy. Scar tissue can force the retina to peel away from the tissue beneath it, like wallpaper peeling away from a wall. A retina that comes completely loose, or detaches, can cause blindness.

chunks.text_zh:
远离其下面的组织，就像壁纸从墙上剥落一样。视网膜完全松动或脱落可能导致失明。

在玻璃体切除术期间，将透明的盐溶液轻轻地泵入眼中，以在手术过程中维持眼压并替换移除的玻璃体。玻璃体切除术是在手术中心或医院使用止痛药进行的。

白内障晶状体手术

在手术中心或医院就诊时，您的医生可以摘除您眼睛中白内障生长的浑浊晶状体，并用人造晶状体替换它。接受白内障手术的人术后视力通常会更好。眼睛痊愈后，您可能需要新的眼镜处方。白内障手术后您的视力还可能取决于糖尿病视网膜病变或黄斑水肿造成的任何损害的治疗。

我能做些什么来保护我的眼睛？

为了预防糖尿病眼病或防止其恶化，请管理您的糖尿病 ABC：A1c、血压和胆固醇；如果您吸烟，请戒烟。阅读有关如何管理糖尿病的更多信息。
chunks.text_en:
away from the tissue beneath it, like wallpaper peeling away from a wall. A retina that comes completely loose, or detaches, can cause blindness.

During vitrectomy, a clear salt solution is gently pumped into the eye to maintain eye pressure during surgery and to replace the removed vitreous. Vitrectomy is done in a surgery center or hospital with pain medicine.

Cataract Lens Surgery

In a surgery center or hospital visit, your doctor can remove the cloudy lens in your eye, where the cataract has grown, and replace it with an artificial lens. People who have cataract surgery generally have better vision afterward. After your eye heals, you may need a new prescription for your glasses. Your vision following cataract surgery may also depend on treating any damage from diabetic retinopathy or macular edema.

What can I do to protect my eyes?

To prevent diabetic eye disease, or to keep it from getting worse, manage your diabetes ABCs: your A1c, blood pressure, and cholesterol; and quit smoking if you smoke. Read more information on how to manage diabetes .

chunks.text_zh:
您的糖尿病 ABC：您的 A1c、血压和胆固醇；如果您吸烟，请戒烟。阅读有关如何管理糖尿病的更多信息。

此外，每年至少进行一次散瞳眼科检查，或者如果您的眼科护理专业人士建议的话，可以更频繁地进行检查。这些行动是保护眼睛健康的有力方法，并且可以防止失明。

越早控制糖尿病和其他健康状况越好。而且，即使您过去一直在努力管理自己的健康，现在更好地照顾自己可以为未来保护您的眼睛。开始永远不会太晚。

如果我已经因糖尿病而出现一些视力丧失怎么办？

请您的眼保健专家帮助您找到低视力和康复诊所。特殊的眼科护理专业人员可以帮助您控制无法通过眼镜、隐形眼镜、药物或手术矫正的视力丧失。特殊的设备和培训可以帮助您充分利用剩余的视力，以便您可以继续保持活跃、享受爱好、拜访朋友和家人以及在没有他人帮助的情况下生活。
chunks.text_en:
your diabetes ABCs: your A1c, blood pressure, and cholesterol; and quit smoking if you smoke. Read more information on how to manage diabetes .

Also, have a dilated eye exam at least once a year—or more often if recommended by your eye care professional. These actions are powerful ways to protect the health of your eyes—and can prevent blindness.

The sooner you work to manage your diabetes and other health conditions, the better. And, even if you’ve struggled in the past to manage your health, taking better care of yourself now can protect your eyes for the future. It’s never too late to begin.

What if I already have some vision loss from diabetes?

Ask your eye care professional to help you find a low vision and rehabilitation clinic. Special eye care professionals can help you manage vision loss that cannot be corrected with glasses, contact lenses, medicine, or surgery. Special devices and training may help you make the most of your remaining vision so that you can continue to be active, enjoy hobbies, visit friends and family members, and live without help from others.

title: 糖尿病肾病
content:
糖尿病肾病

在本节中：

什么是糖尿病肾病？

糖尿病肾病是一种由糖尿病引起的肾脏疾病。

糖尿病是肾脏疾病的主要原因。大约 1 out of 3 名成年糖尿病患者患有肾脏疾病。

肾脏的主要工作是过滤血液中的废物和多余的水以产生尿液。您的肾脏还有助于控制血压并产生身体保持健康所需的激素。

当您的肾脏受损时，它们无法正常过滤血液，这可能会导致废物在您的体内堆积。肾脏损伤还会导致其他健康问题。

糖尿病引起的肾脏损害通常会缓慢发生，持续多年。您可以采取措施保护您的肾脏并预防或延缓肾脏损伤。

观看有关糖尿病和肾脏疾病的视频。

糖尿病肾病还有哪些其他名称？

糖尿病肾病也称为DKD、慢性肾病、CKD、糖尿病肾病或糖尿病肾病。

糖尿病如何引发肾脏疾病？

What is diabetic kidney disease?

Diabetic kidney disease is a type of kidney disease caused by diabetes .

Diabetes is the leading cause of kidney disease. About 1 out of 3 adults with diabetes has kidney disease.

The main job of the kidneys is to filter wastes and extra water out of your blood to make urine. Your kidneys also help control blood pressure and make hormones that your body needs to stay healthy.

When your kidneys are damaged, they can’t filter blood like they should, which can cause wastes to build up in your body. Kidney damage can also cause other health problems.

Kidney damage caused by diabetes usually occurs slowly, over many years. You can take steps to protect your kidneys and to prevent or delay kidney damage.

Watch a video about diabetes and kidney disease .

What are other names for diabetic kidney disease?

Diabetic kidney disease is also called DKD, chronic kidney disease, CKD, kidney disease of diabetes, or diabetic nephropathy.

Most people with diabetic kidney disease do not have symptoms. The only way to know if you have diabetic kidney disease is to get your kidneys checked.

Health care professionals use blood and urine tests to check for diabetic kidney disease. Your health care professional will check your urine for albumin and will also do a blood test to see how well your kidneys are filtering your blood.

How can I cope with the stress of managing my diabetes?

Managing diabetes isn’t always easy. Feeling stressed, sad, or angry is common when you are living with diabetes. You may know what to do to stay healthy but may have trouble sticking with your plan over time. Long-term stress can raise your blood glucose and blood pressure, but you can learn ways to lower your stress. Try deep breathing, gardening, taking a walk, doing yoga, meditating, doing a hobby, or listening to your favorite music. Learn more about healthy ways to cope with stress .

Does diabetic kidney disease get worse over time?

Kidney damage from diabetes can get worse over time. However, you can take steps to keep your kidneys healthy and help slow kidney damage to prevent or delay kidney failure . Kidney failure means that your kidneys have lost most of their ability to function—less than 15 percent of normal kidney function. However, most people with diabetes and kidney disease don’t end up with kidney failure.

title: 糖尿病神经病变
content:
糖尿病神经病变

Diabetic neuropathy is nerve damage that can occur in people with diabetes. Different types of nerve damage cause different symptoms. Symptoms can range from pain and numbness in your feet to problems with the functions of your internal organs, such as your heart and bladder.

What Is Diabetic Neuropathy?

Diabetic neuropathy is nerve damage that is caused by diabetes. Over time, high blood glucose levels, also called blood sugar, and high levels of fats, such as triglycerides, in the blood from diabetes can damage your nerves. Symptoms depend on which type of diabetic neuropathy you have.

Peripheral Neuropathy

Autonomic Neuropathy

Autonomic neuropathy is damage to nerves that control your internal organs, leading to problems with your heart rate and blood pressure, digestive system, bladder, sex organs, sweat glands, and eyes. The damage can also lead to hypoglycemia unawareness.

Focal Neuropathies

Focal neuropathies are conditions in which you typically have damage to single nerves, most often in your hand, head, torso, or leg. The most common types of focal neuropathy are entrapment syndromes, such as carpal tunnel syndrome. Other types of focal neuropathy are much less common.

Proximal Neuropathy

Proximal neuropathy is a rare and disabling type of nerve damage in your hip, buttock, or thigh. The damage typically affects one side of your body and may rarely spread to the other side. Symptoms gradually improve over a period of months or years.

title: 自主神经病变
content:
自主神经病变

在本节中：

什么是自主神经病？

自主神经病变是控制内脏器官的神经受损。

自主神经病变可能会导致您的问题

心率和血压

消化系统

膀胱

性器官

汗腺

眼睛

感知低血糖的能力，也称为低血糖或低血糖——一种称为低血糖无意识的情况

自主神经病变的原因是什么？

随着时间的推移，糖尿病引起的血液中的高血糖和高脂肪（例如甘油三酯）会损害您的神经和滋养神经的小血管，导致自主神经病变。

自主神经病变有哪些症状？

自主神经病变的症状取决于您身体的哪些功能受到影响。

自主神经病变的症状是什么？

自主神经病变的症状取决于您身体的哪些功能受到影响。

控制心率和血压的神经受损可能会使这些神经对身体姿势、压力、身体活动、睡眠和呼吸模式的变化的反应更慢。当您从躺下或坐着站起来或进行体力活动时，您可能会感到头晕或晕厥。您的心率可能很快，或者您的心率可能突然加快或减慢。当您的心脏缺氧或心脏病发作时，神经损伤还可以防止您感到胸痛。

消化系统神经受损可能会导致以下症状：

腹胀、饱腹感和恶心

便秘

腹泻，尤其是在夜间

腹泻与便秘交替出现

大便失禁

吞咽问题

呕吐

和恶心

腹泻与便秘交替出现

大便失禁

吞咽问题

自主神经病变也可能引起胃轻瘫。胃轻瘫是一种会减慢或阻止食物从胃到小肠的移动的疾病。胃轻瘫会使您的身体无法正确吸收葡萄糖和使用胰岛素。这些问题会使您难以控制血糖。

膀胱神经受损可能会导致您很难知道何时需要排尿以及膀胱何时排空。这种损害可能会导致您憋尿时间过长，从而导致膀胱感染。您也可能会漏尿。漏尿或无法憋尿称为尿失禁。

对于男性来说，性器官神经受损可能会导致男性想要做爱时阴茎无法变硬。这种情况称为勃起功能障碍，也称为 ED。男性也可能有射精问题。

当男人想要做爱时坚定。这种情况称为勃起功能障碍，也称为 ED。男性也可能有射精问题。

对于女性来说，当女性想要做爱时，性器官神经的损伤会阻止阴道变湿。女性的阴道周围的感觉也可能较差，并且可能难以达到性高潮。

控制汗腺的神经受损可能会导致您在夜间或进食时大量出汗。您的汗腺可能根本不起作用，或者身体的某些部位可能出汗，而其他部位却干燥。如果您的汗腺无法正常工作，您的身体可能无法控制温度。

瞳孔神经受损可能会使它们对明暗变化的反应缓慢。当您进入黑暗的房间时，您的眼睛可能需要更长的时间来适应。夜间驾驶时，您可能很难看清其他车辆的灯光。

感受低血糖症状的能力

当你进入一个黑暗的房间时。夜间驾驶时，您可能很难看清其他车辆的灯光。

感受低血糖症状的能力

自主神经病变会导致低血糖无意识，这意味着您感觉不到低血糖的症状。通常，低血糖的早期症状包括感到困惑、头晕、饥饿、烦躁或紧张。如果神经损伤使您感觉不到这些症状，您可能不会采取措施治疗低血糖。如果不治疗，您可能会出现严重的低血糖，从而导致昏倒。您将立即需要帮助来应对严重的低血糖症。

医生如何诊断自主神经病变？

医生根据您的症状、家族史和病史、体检和测试来诊断自主神经病变。您的医生会检查您的心率和血压，并可能进行其他检查以检查不同类型的自主神经损伤。

医生使用哪些测试来诊断自主神经病变？

并可能进行额外的测试来检查不同类型的自主神经损伤。

医生使用哪些测试来诊断自主神经病变？

为了诊断自主神经病变，您的医生可能会使用一些测试来评估您对深呼吸或站立等简单运动的心率变化。您的医生还可能使用测试来检查您的汗液功能，以了解您的神经和汗腺的工作情况。

根据您的症状，医生也可能会使用

检查以排除消化系统症状的其他原因，例如便秘和腹泻

胃排空闪烁扫描和胃排空呼气试验诊断胃轻瘫

对膀胱和尿路进行超声波检查，以检查膀胱的工作情况

躺下时检查血压，站起来后检查血压

我如何帮助治疗自主神经病变？

您可以通过控制糖尿病来帮助治疗自主神经病变，这意味着控制您的血糖、血压和胆固醇。保持接近目标数字可以防止神经损伤恶化。

意味着管理您的血糖、血压和胆固醇。保持接近目标数字可以防止神经损伤恶化。

医生如何治疗自主神经病变？

您的医生可能会治疗自主神经损伤引起的症状。

您的医生将治疗影响您心率和血压的神经损伤症状。您的医生可能会推荐

进行更多的体力活动

如果站立时血压降得太低，则增加饮食中的盐分

增加喝液体的量

抬高床头或穿弹力袜以改善血液流动

缓慢地坐着或站着，以防止头晕或昏厥

避免低血糖

您的医生还可能会开出帮助您的身体保留盐分的药物、帮助升高血压的药物或提高或降低心率的药物。

您的医生可能会建议改变您的饮食和非处方药或处方药来治疗消化系统症状和问题，例如

腹泻

胃食管反流

胃轻瘫

以及治疗消化系统症状和问题的非处方药或处方药，例如

腹泻

胃食管反流

胃轻瘫

了解有关这些消化症状和问题的更多信息。

在服用任何非处方药来治疗消化问题之前，请先咨询您的医生。您的医生可能会将您转介给胃肠病专家进行治疗。

您的医生会通过关注您的症状来治疗您的膀胱问题。如果您有尿失禁，您的医生可能会建议您定期去洗手间，因为您可能无法判断膀胱何时充满。

您的医生也可能会开药来帮助治疗尿失禁，或者在您无法完全排空膀胱时提供帮助。

如果您患有膀胱感染，您的医生可能会开抗生素并建议您多喝液体以帮助预防未来感染。

医生可能会推荐治疗勃起功能障碍的药物或设备。医生可能会将男性转介给泌尿科医生来治疗性问题。

可能会推荐治疗勃起功能障碍的药物或设备。医生可能会将男性转介给泌尿科医生来治疗性问题。

为了治疗女性的性问题，医生可能会将女性转介给妇科医生。当神经病变导致阴道干燥时，医生可能会建议使用阴道润滑剂。

如果您出汗过多，医生可能会建议

避免过多的热量或湿度

处方止汗剂或减少出汗的药物

切断汗腺神经或切除汗腺的手术

低血糖无意识

如果与糖尿病相关的神经损伤导致低血糖，您可能需要更频繁地检查血糖，以便知道何时需要治疗低血糖或采取措施预防低血糖。

您的医生可能会开出连续血糖监测仪 (CGM)。 CGM 会在白天和晚上定期检查您的血糖水平。 CGM 可以告诉您血糖是否快速下降，并在您的血糖降得太低时发出警报。

整个白天和晚上。 CGM 可以告诉您血糖是否快速下降，并在您的血糖降得太低时发出警报。

如果您因严重低血糖而昏倒，需要有人给您注射胰高血糖素并致电9-1-1。注射胰高血糖素会很快使您的血糖恢复正常。询问您的医生何时以及如何使用胰高血糖素应急包。考虑佩戴糖尿病医疗警报 ID 手链或吊坠。如果您昏倒，此医疗警报 ID 会告诉其他人您患有糖尿病并需要立即护理。

are the symptoms of autonomic neuropathy?

The symptoms of autonomic neuropathy depend on which of your body’s functions are affected.

Damage to the nerves that control your heart rate and blood pressure may make these nerves respond more slowly to a change in your body’s position, stress, physical activity, sleep, and breathing patterns. You may feel light-headed or faint when you stand up from lying down or sitting, or when you do a physical activity. You may have a rapid heart rate, or your heart rate may suddenly speed up or slow down. Nerve damage can also prevent you from feeling chest pain when your heart is not getting enough oxygen or when you are having a heart attack .

Damage to the nerves of your digestive system can cause symptoms such as the following:

bloating , fullness, and nausea

constipation

diarrhea , especially at night

diarrhea alternating with constipation

fecal incontinence

problems swallowing

vomiting

chunks.text_en:
and nausea

constipation

diarrhea , especially at night

diarrhea alternating with constipation

fecal incontinence

problems swallowing

vomiting

Autonomic neuropathy may also cause gastroparesis . Gastroparesis is a disorder that slows or stops the movement of food from your stomach to your small intestine. Gastroparesis can keep your body from absorbing glucose and using insulin properly. These problems can make it hard to manage your blood glucose.

Damage to the nerves of your bladder may make it hard to know when you need to urinate and when your bladder is empty. This damage can cause you to hold urine for too long, which can lead to bladder infections . You may also leak drops of urine. Leaking urine or not being able to hold urine is called urinary incontinence .

In men, damage to nerves in the sex organs may prevent the penis from getting firm when a man wants to have sex. This condition is called erectile dysfunction , also called ED. Men also may have problems with ejaculation .

chunks.text_zh:
当男人想要做爱时坚定。这种情况称为勃起功能障碍，也称为 ED。男性也可能有射精问题。

对于女性来说，当女性想要做爱时，性器官神经的损伤会阻止阴道变湿。女性的阴道周围的感觉也可能较差，并且可能难以达到性高潮。

控制汗腺的神经受损可能会导致您在夜间或进食时大量出汗。您的汗腺可能根本不起作用，或者身体的某些部位可能出汗，而其他部位却干燥。如果您的汗腺无法正常工作，您的身体可能无法控制温度。

瞳孔神经受损可能会使它们对明暗变化的反应缓慢。当您进入黑暗的房间时，您的眼睛可能需要更长的时间来适应。夜间驾驶时，您可能很难看清其他车辆的灯光。

感受低血糖症状的能力
chunks.text_en:
firm when a man wants to have sex. This condition is called erectile dysfunction , also called ED. Men also may have problems with ejaculation .

In women, damage to the nerves in the sex organs can prevent the vagina from getting wet when a woman wants to have sex. A woman might also have less feeling around her vagina and may have trouble having an orgasm.

Damage to the nerves that control your sweat glands may cause you to sweat a lot at night or while eating. Your sweat glands may not work at all, or certain parts of your body may sweat while other parts are dry. If your sweat glands do not work properly, your body may not be able to control its temperature.

Damage to the nerves in your pupils may make them slow to respond to changes in light and darkness. Your eyes may take longer to adjust when you enter a dark room. You may have trouble seeing the lights of other cars when driving at night.

Ability to feel symptoms of hypoglycemia

chunks.text_zh:
当你进入一个黑暗的房间时。夜间驾驶时，您可能很难看清其他车辆的灯光。

感受低血糖症状的能力

自主神经病变会导致低血糖无意识，这意味着您感觉不到低血糖的症状。通常，低血糖的早期症状包括感到困惑、头晕、饥饿、烦躁或紧张。如果神经损伤使您感觉不到这些症状，您可能不会采取措施治疗低血糖。如果不治疗，您可能会出现严重的低血糖，从而导致昏倒。您将立即需要帮助来应对严重的低血糖症。

医生如何诊断自主神经病变？

医生根据您的症状、家族史和病史、体检和测试来诊断自主神经病变。您的医生会检查您的心率和血压，并可能进行其他检查以检查不同类型的自主神经损伤。

医生使用哪些测试来诊断自主神经病变？
chunks.text_en:
when you enter a dark room. You may have trouble seeing the lights of other cars when driving at night.

Ability to feel symptoms of hypoglycemia

Autonomic neuropathy can cause hypoglycemia unawareness, meaning that you don’t feel the symptoms of low blood glucose . Normally, early symptoms of low blood glucose can include feeling confused, dizzy, hungry, irritable, or nervous. If nerve damage keeps you from feeling these symptoms, you may not take steps to treat your low blood glucose. Without treatment, you may develop severe hypoglycemia, which can cause you to pass out. You will need help right away to deal with severe hypoglycemia.

How do doctors diagnose autonomic neuropathy?

Doctors diagnose autonomic neuropathy based on your symptoms, family and medical history, a physical exam, and tests. Your doctor will check your heart rate and blood pressure and may perform additional tests to check for different types of autonomic nerve damage.

What tests do doctors use to diagnose autonomic neuropathy?

chunks.text_zh:
并可能进行额外的测试来检查不同类型的自主神经损伤。

医生使用哪些测试来诊断自主神经病变？

为了诊断自主神经病变，您的医生可能会使用一些测试来评估您对深呼吸或站立等简单运动的心率变化。您的医生还可能使用测试来检查您的汗液功能，以了解您的神经和汗腺的工作情况。

根据您的症状，医生也可能会使用

检查以排除消化系统症状的其他原因，例如便秘和腹泻

胃排空闪烁扫描和胃排空呼气试验诊断胃轻瘫

对膀胱和尿路进行超声波检查，以检查膀胱的工作情况

躺下时检查血压，站起来后检查血压

我如何帮助治疗自主神经病变？

您可以通过控制糖尿病来帮助治疗自主神经病变，这意味着控制您的血糖、血压和胆固醇。保持接近目标数字可以防止神经损伤恶化。
chunks.text_en:
and may perform additional tests to check for different types of autonomic nerve damage.

What tests do doctors use to diagnose autonomic neuropathy?

To diagnose autonomic neuropathy, your doctor may use a few tests to assess changes in your heart rate in response to simple movements such as deep breathing or standing. Your doctor may also use tests to check your sweat function to know how your nerves and sweat glands are working.

Depending on your symptoms, you doctor may also use

tests to rule out other causes of digestive symptoms, such as constipation and diarrhea

gastric emptying scintigraphy and gastric emptying breath tests to diagnose gastroparesis

ultrasounds of your bladder and urinary tract to check how your bladder is working

blood pressure checks while you are lying down and then after you stand up

How can I help treat autonomic neuropathy?

You can help treat autonomic neuropathy by managing your diabetes , which means managing your blood glucose, blood pressure, and cholesterol. Staying close to your goal numbers can keep nerve damage from getting worse.

chunks.text_zh:
意味着管理您的血糖、血压和胆固醇。保持接近目标数字可以防止神经损伤恶化。

医生如何治疗自主神经病变？

您的医生可能会治疗自主神经损伤引起的症状。

您的医生将治疗影响您心率和血压的神经损伤症状。您的医生可能会推荐

进行更多的体力活动

如果站立时血压降得太低，则增加饮食中的盐分

增加喝液体的量

抬高床头或穿弹力袜以改善血液流动

缓慢地坐着或站着，以防止头晕或昏厥

避免低血糖

您的医生还可能会开出帮助您的身体保留盐分的药物、帮助升高血压的药物或提高或降低心率的药物。

您的医生可能会建议改变您的饮食和非处方药或处方药来治疗消化系统症状和问题，例如

腹泻

胃食管反流

胃轻瘫
chunks.text_en:
means managing your blood glucose, blood pressure, and cholesterol. Staying close to your goal numbers can keep nerve damage from getting worse.

How do doctors treat autonomic neuropathy?

Your doctor may treat the symptoms caused by autonomic nerve damage.

Your doctor will treat the symptoms of nerve damage that affect your heart rate and blood pressure. Your doctor may recommend

getting more physical activity

increasing salt in your diet if your blood pressure drops too low when you stand up

increasing the amount of liquids you drink

raising the head of your bed or wearing elastic stockings to improve blood flow

sitting or standing slowly to prevent light-headedness or fainting

avoiding hypoglycemia

Your doctor may also prescribe medicines that help your body retain salt, medicines to help raise your blood pressure, or medicines that raise or lower your heart rate.

Your doctor may recommend changes to your diet and over-the-counter or prescription medicines to treat digestive symptoms and problems such as

diarrhea

gastroesophageal reflux

gastroparesis

chunks.text_zh:
以及治疗消化系统症状和问题的非处方药或处方药，例如

腹泻

胃食管反流

胃轻瘫

了解有关这些消化症状和问题的更多信息。

在服用任何非处方药来治疗消化问题之前，请先咨询您的医生。您的医生可能会将您转介给胃肠病专家进行治疗。

您的医生会通过关注您的症状来治疗您的膀胱问题。如果您有尿失禁，您的医生可能会建议您定期去洗手间，因为您可能无法判断膀胱何时充满。

您的医生也可能会开药来帮助治疗尿失禁，或者在您无法完全排空膀胱时提供帮助。

如果您患有膀胱感染，您的医生可能会开抗生素并建议您多喝液体以帮助预防未来感染。

医生可能会推荐治疗勃起功能障碍的药物或设备。医生可能会将男性转介给泌尿科医生来治疗性问题。
chunks.text_en:
and over-the-counter or prescription medicines to treat digestive symptoms and problems such as

diarrhea

gastroesophageal reflux

gastroparesis

Read more about these digestive symptoms and problems .

Talk with your doctor before taking any over-the-counter medicines to treat problems with digestion. Your doctor may refer you to a gastroenterologist for treatment.

Your doctor will treat your bladder problems by focusing on your symptoms. If you have incontinence, your doctor may recommend planning regular trips to the bathroom because you may not be able to tell when your bladder is full.

Your doctor may also prescribe medicines to help with incontinence or help if you have problems completely emptying your bladder.

If you have a bladder infection, your doctor may prescribe an antibiotic and suggest drinking plenty of liquids to help prevent future infections.

Doctors may recommend medicines or devices to treat erectile dysfunction . Doctors may refer men to a urologist to treat sexual problems.

chunks.text_zh:
可能会推荐治疗勃起功能障碍的药物或设备。医生可能会将男性转介给泌尿科医生来治疗性问题。

为了治疗女性的性问题，医生可能会将女性转介给妇科医生。当神经病变导致阴道干燥时，医生可能会建议使用阴道润滑剂。

如果您出汗过多，医生可能会建议

避免过多的热量或湿度

处方止汗剂或减少出汗的药物

切断汗腺神经或切除汗腺的手术

低血糖无意识

如果与糖尿病相关的神经损伤导致低血糖，您可能需要更频繁地检查血糖，以便知道何时需要治疗低血糖或采取措施预防低血糖。

您的医生可能会开出连续血糖监测仪 (CGM)。 CGM 会在白天和晚上定期检查您的血糖水平。 CGM 可以告诉您血糖是否快速下降，并在您的血糖降得太低时发出警报。
chunks.text_en:
may recommend medicines or devices to treat erectile dysfunction . Doctors may refer men to a urologist to treat sexual problems.

To treat sexual problems in women, doctors may refer women to a gynecologist. Doctors may recommend vaginal lubricants when neuropathy causes vaginal dryness.

If you have too much sweating, your doctor may suggest

avoiding too much heat or humidity

a prescription antiperspirant or medicine to decrease sweating

surgery to cut the nerves in the sweat glands or to remove sweat glands

Hypoglycemia unawareness

If diabetes-related nerve damage leads to hypoglycemia unawareness, you may need to check your blood glucose more often, so you know when you need to treat hypoglycemia or take steps to prevent it.

Your doctor may prescribe a continuous glucose monitor (CGM). A CGM checks your blood glucose levels at regular times throughout the day and night. CGMs can tell you if your blood glucose is falling quickly and sound an alarm if your blood glucose falls too low.

chunks.text_zh:
整个白天和晚上。 CGM 可以告诉您血糖是否快速下降，并在您的血糖降得太低时发出警报。

如果您因严重低血糖而昏倒，需要有人给您注射胰高血糖素并致电9-1-1。注射胰高血糖素会很快使您的血糖恢复正常。询问您的医生何时以及如何使用胰高血糖素应急包。考虑佩戴糖尿病医疗警报 ID 手链或吊坠。如果您昏倒，此医疗警报 ID 会告诉其他人您患有糖尿病并需要立即护理。

If you pass out due to severe hypoglycemia , someone will need to give you a glucagon injection and call 9-1-1. An injection of glucagon will quickly raise your blood glucose back to normal. Ask your doctor about when and how to use a glucagon emergency kit. Consider wearing a diabetes medical alert ID bracelet or pendant. If you pass out, this medical alert ID will tell other people that you have diabetes and need care right away.

title: 局灶性神经病变
content:
局灶性神经病变

在本节中：

什么是局灶性神经病？

局灶性神经病是指单个神经通常受到损害的病症，最常见的是手、头、躯干或腿。这种类型的神经损伤比周围神经病或自主神经病少见。

许多不同的局灶性神经病变都会影响糖尿病患者。

陷阱

卡压或卡压综合征是最常见的局灶性神经病类型。当神经被压缩或被困在神经穿过骨骼和组织之间狭窄通道的区域时，就会发生卡压。患有糖尿病的人比没有糖尿病的人更容易出现卡压。

最常见的卡压称为腕管综合症。虽然只有不到 10 百分比 的糖尿病患者会出现腕管综合征症状，但大约 25 百分比 的糖尿病患者会出现手腕神经受压的情况。

其他局灶性神经病

感觉到腕管综合症的症状，大约 25 百分比 的糖尿病患者的手腕神经受到一定程度的压迫。

其他局灶性神经病

其他不涉及神经受困的局灶性神经病则不太常见。这些局灶性神经病最常影响老年人。例子包括影响头部神经的颅神经病。颅神经病变会导致眼睛问题或面部肌肉问题。症状取决于受影响的神经。

局灶性神经病的病因是什么？

随着时间的推移，糖尿病引起的血液中的高血糖（也称为血糖）和高水平的脂肪（例如甘油三酯）会损害您的神经和滋养神经的小血管，导致局灶性神经病。

局灶性神经病有哪些症状？

卡压（涉及神经卡压的局灶性神经病）会导致逐渐出现的症状，并随着时间的推移而恶化。例子包括

涉及神经受困的神经病——导致症状逐渐出现，并随着时间的推移而恶化。例子包括

腕管综合症，会导致拇指、食指和中指疼痛、麻木和刺痛，有时还会导致握力无力

尺骨卡压，导致小指和无名指疼痛、麻木和刺痛

腓骨卡压，导致小腿外侧疼痛和大脚趾无力

不涉及受困神经的局灶性神经病会导致突然出现的症状，并在几周或几个月后改善。根据受影响的神经，您可能会出现疼痛和其他症状

手

腿

脚

躯干

颅神经病（影响头部神经的局灶性神经病）可能会导致以下症状：

一只眼睛后面疼痛

复视

一侧脸部瘫痪，称为贝尔麻痹

眼睛聚焦问题

医生如何诊断局灶性神经病？

眼睛

复视

一侧脸部瘫痪，称为贝尔麻痹

眼睛聚焦问题

医生如何诊断局灶性神经病？

医生通过询问您的症状并进行神经传导研究和肌电图 (EMG) 等测试来诊断局灶性神经病。神经传导研究检查电信号通过身体不同部位神经的速度。肌电图显示您的肌肉对神经的反应。

医生如何治疗局灶性神经病？

您的医生可能会使用治疗周围神经病变疼痛的相同药物来治疗局灶性神经病变疼痛。

要治疗涉及神经受困的局灶性神经病，您的医生可能会建议

佩戴夹板或支架以减轻神经压力

减轻炎症的药物

如果其他治疗无效，则进行手术

对于不涉及神经受困的局灶性神经病，即使不进行治疗，大多数人也会在几周或几个月内康复。

Focal Neuropathies

In this section:

What are focal neuropathies?

Focal neuropathies are conditions in which you typically have damage to single nerves, most often in your hand, head, torso, or leg. This type of nerve damage is less common than peripheral or autonomic neuropathy.

Many different focal neuropathies can affect people who have diabetes.

Entrapments

Entrapments, or entrapment syndromes, are the most common type of focal neuropathy. Entrapments occur when nerves become compressed or trapped in areas where nerves pass through narrow passages between bones and tissues. People with diabetes are more likely to have entrapments than people without diabetes.

The most common entrapment is called carpal tunnel syndrome . Although less than 10 percent of people with diabetes feel symptoms of carpal tunnel syndrome, about 25 percent of people with diabetes have some nerve compression at the wrist.

Other focal neuropathies

其他局灶性神经病

其他不涉及神经受困的局灶性神经病则不太常见。这些局灶性神经病最常影响老年人。例子包括影响头部神经的颅神经病。颅神经病变会导致眼睛问题或面部肌肉问题。症状取决于受影响的神经。

Other focal neuropathies

Other focal neuropathies that do not involve trapped nerves are much less common. These focal neuropathies most often affect older adults. Examples include cranial neuropathies, which affect the nerves of the head. Cranial neuropathies can cause eye problems or problems with the muscles of the face. Symptoms depend on which nerve is affected.

What causes focal neuropathies?

Over time, high blood glucose, also called blood sugar, and high levels of fats, such as triglycerides , in the blood from diabetes can damage your nerves and the small blood vessels that nourish your nerves, leading to focal neuropathies.

What are the symptoms of focal neuropathies?

Entrapments—focal neuropathies that involve trapped nerves—cause symptoms that begin gradually and get worse over time. Examples include

How do doctors diagnose focal neuropathies?

Doctors diagnose focal neuropathies by asking about your symptoms and performing tests, such as nerve conduction studies and electromyography (EMG) . Nerve conduction studies check how fast electrical signals move through your nerves in different parts of your body. EMG shows how your muscles respond to your nerves.

Your doctor may treat focal neuropathy pain with the same medicines used to treat peripheral neuropathy pain .

title: 周围神经病变
content:
周围神经病变

在本节中：

什么是周围神经病？

周围神经病变是一种神经损伤，通常影响脚和腿，有时也会影响手和手臂。

这种类型的神经病很常见。多达一半的糖尿病患者患有周围神经病变。

周围神经病变的原因是什么？

随着时间的推移，糖尿病引起的血液中的高血糖（也称为血糖）和高水平的脂肪（例如甘油三酯）会损害您的神经和滋养神经的小血管，导致周围神经病变。

周围神经病变有哪些症状？

如果您患有周围神经病变，您的脚、腿、手或手臂可能会感觉

燃烧

刺痛，就像“发麻”

麻木的

痛苦的

弱

即使轻轻触摸，您的脚、腿、手和手臂也可能会感到极度疼痛。您可能还无法感知身体这些部位的疼痛或温度。

脚、腿、手和手臂，即使是轻轻触摸。您可能还无法感知身体这些部位的疼痛或温度。

症状通常在夜间更为严重。大多数时候，您身体两侧都会出现症状。但是，您可能仅在一侧出现症状。

如果您患有周围神经病变，您可能会遇到：

你走路方式的改变

失去平衡，这可能会让你更频繁地跌倒

手脚肌肉张力丧失

走路时疼痛

感知运动或位置的问题

脚肿了

周围神经病变会引起哪些问题？

周围神经病变会导致足部问题，从而导致水泡和溃疡。如果周围神经病变导致您的脚失去知觉，您可能不会注意到导致水泡和溃疡的压力或受伤。糖尿病会使这些伤口难以愈合并增加感染的机会。这些溃疡和感染可能会导致脚趾、脚或腿部的一部分丧失。及早发现并治疗足部问题可以降低发生严重感染的机会。

失去脚趾、脚或腿部的一部分。及早发现并治疗足部问题可以降低发生严重感染的机会。

这种与糖尿病相关的神经损伤也会导致脚和脚趾形状的变化。夏科氏足是某些糖尿病患者可能出现的一种罕见疾病，这是一种足部骨骼和组织受损的问题。

周围神经病变会使您更容易失去平衡和跌倒，从而增加骨折和其他伤害的机会。周围神经病变的慢性疼痛也会导致悲伤、焦虑和抑郁。

医生如何诊断周围神经病变？

医生根据您的症状、家族史和病史、体检和检查来诊断周围神经病。体检包括神经系统检查和足部检查。

神经病检查

家族史和病史、体检和测试。体检包括神经系统检查和足部检查。

神经病检查

如果您患有糖尿病，您应该至少每年进行一次彻底的检查，以测试您的脚和腿的感觉。在这项检查中，您的医生会检查您的脚是否有问题的迹象，并通过以下方式检查您脚的血流量和感觉或感觉：

将音叉放在大脚趾上并放在脚的较高位置，检查是否能感觉到振动

用尼龙线接触每只脚和一些脚趾，看看是否能感觉到它——这个过程称为单丝测试

检查您的步态或行走时的模式

测试你的平衡能力

您的医生也可能会检查您是否能感觉到脚部的温度变化。

医生使用哪些测试来诊断周围神经病变？

平衡

您的医生也可能会检查您是否能感觉到脚部的温度变化。

医生使用哪些测试来诊断周围神经病变？

您的医生可能会进行检查以排除神经损伤的其他原因，例如进行血液检查以检查是否有甲状腺问题、肾脏疾病或维生素 B12 水平低。如果发现 B12 水平较低，您的医生将进行额外的检查以确定原因。使用二甲双胍是导致维生素 B12 水平低的几个原因之一。如果 B12 缺乏是由二甲双胍引起的，可以继续服用二甲双胍并补充 B12。

如何预防周围神经病变引起的问题？

您可以通过控制糖尿病来预防周围神经病变引起的问题，这意味着控制血糖、血压和胆固醇。保持接近目标数字可以防止神经损伤恶化。

如果您患有糖尿病，请每天检查双脚是否有问题，并好好护理双脚。如果您发现任何足部问题，请立即致电或去看医生。

每天检查双脚是否有问题，并好好护理双脚。如果您发现任何足部问题，请立即致电或去看医生。

在检查室脱掉袜子和鞋子，提醒您的医生在每次就诊时检查您的脚。每年至少去看医生一次足部检查——如果您有足部问题，则应更频繁地进行足部检查。您的医生可能会带您去看足病医生。

医生如何治疗周围神经病变？

医生可能会开药和其他治疗疼痛的药物。

治疗神经痛的药物

您的医生可能会开药来缓解疼痛，例如某些类型的药物

三环类抗抑郁药，例如去甲替林、地昔帕明、丙咪嗪和阿米替林

其他类型的抗抑郁药，如度洛西汀、文拉法辛、帕罗西汀和西酞普兰

抗惊厥药——用于治疗癫痫发作的药物——例如加巴喷丁和普瑞巴林

护肤霜、贴剂或喷雾剂，例如利多卡因

旨在治疗癫痫发作——例如加巴喷丁和普瑞巴林

护肤霜、贴剂或喷雾剂，例如利多卡因

尽管这些药物可以缓解疼痛，但它们不能改变神经损伤。因此，如果治疗疼痛的药物没有改善，继续服用也没有什么好处，可以尝试其他药物。

所有药物都有副作用。向您的医生询问您服用的任何药物的副作用。医生不建议老年人或患有心脏病等其他健康问题的人使用某些药物。

一些医生建议避免使用非处方止痛药，例如对乙酰氨基酚和布洛芬。这些药物可能无法很好地治疗大多数神经疼痛，并且可能有副作用。

神经痛的其他治疗方法

您的医生可能会推荐其他疼痛治疗方法，包括

物理治疗可提高您的力量和平衡能力

床摇篮，一种在你睡觉时让床单和毯子远离你的腿和脚的装置

提高力量和平衡能力的疗法

床摇篮，一种在你睡觉时让床单和毯子远离你的腿和脚的装置

糖尿病专家尚未对糖尿病患者的补充剂提出特别建议。出于安全原因，请在使用补充剂或任何补充或替代药物或医疗实践之前咨询您的医生。

Peripheral Neuropathy

In this section:

What is peripheral neuropathy?

Peripheral neuropathy is a type of nerve damage that typically affects the feet and legs and sometimes affects the hands and arms.

This type of neuropathy is very common. Up to one-half of people with diabetes have peripheral neuropathy.

What causes peripheral neuropathy?

Over time, high blood glucose, also called blood sugar, and high levels of fats, such as triglycerides , in the blood from diabetes can damage your nerves and the small blood vessels that nourish your nerves, leading to peripheral neuropathy.

What are the symptoms of peripheral neuropathy?

If you have peripheral neuropathy, your feet, legs, hands, or arms may feel

burning

tingling, like “pins and needles”

numb

painful

weak

You may feel extreme pain in your feet, legs, hands, and arms, even when they are touched lightly. You may also have problems sensing pain or temperature in these parts of your body.

Symptoms are often worse at night. Most of the time, you will have symptoms on both sides of your body. However, you may have symptoms only on one side.

If you have peripheral neuropathy, you might experience:

changes in the way you walk

loss of balance, which could make you fall more often

loss of muscle tone in your hands and feet

pain when you walk

problems sensing movement or position

What problems does peripheral neuropathy cause?

Peripheral neuropathy can cause foot problems that lead to blisters and sores. If peripheral neuropathy causes you to lose feeling in your feet, you may not notice pressure or injuries that lead to blisters and sores. Diabetes can make these wounds difficult to heal and increase the chance of infections. These sores and infections can lead to the loss of a toe, foot, or part of your leg. Finding and treating foot problems early can lower the chances that you will develop serious infections.

If you have diabetes, you should get a thorough exam to test how you feel in your feet and legs at least once a year. During this exam, your doctor will look at your feet for signs of problems and check the blood flow and feeling, or sensation, in your feet by

What tests do doctors use to diagnose peripheral neuropathy?

Your doctor may perform tests to rule out other causes of nerve damage, such as a blood test to check for thyroid problems, kidney disease , or low vitamin B12 levels. If low B12 levels are found, your doctor will do additional tests to determine the cause. Metformin use is among several causes of low vitamin B12 levels. If B12 deficiency is due to metformin, metformin can be continued with B12 supplementation.

How can I prevent the problems caused by peripheral neuropathy?

You can prevent the problems caused by peripheral neuropathy by managing your diabetes , which means managing your blood glucose, blood pressure, and cholesterol. Staying close to your goal numbers can keep nerve damage from getting worse.

If you have diabetes, check your feet for problems every day and take good care of your feet . If you notice any foot problems, call or see your doctor right away.

Remove your socks and shoes in the exam room to remind your doctor to check your feet at every office visit. See your doctor for a foot exam at least once a year—more often if you have foot problems. Your doctor may send you to a podiatrist .

How do doctors treat peripheral neuropathy?

Doctors may prescribe medicine and other treatments for pain.

Medicines for nerve pain

Your doctor may prescribe medicines to help with pain, such as certain types of

tricyclic antidepressants, such as nortriptyline , desipramine , imipramine , and amitriptyline

other types of antidepressants, such as duloxetine , venlafaxine , paroxetine , and citalopram

anticonvulsants—medicines designed to treat seizures—such as gabapentin and pregabalin

skin creams, patches, or sprays, such as lidocaine

护肤霜、贴剂或喷雾剂，例如利多卡因

尽管这些药物可以缓解疼痛，但它们不能改变神经损伤。因此，如果治疗疼痛的药物没有改善，继续服用也没有什么好处，可以尝试其他药物。

所有药物都有副作用。向您的医生询问您服用的任何药物的副作用。医生不建议老年人或患有心脏病等其他健康问题的人使用某些药物。

一些医生建议避免使用非处方止痛药，例如对乙酰氨基酚和布洛芬。这些药物可能无法很好地治疗大多数神经疼痛，并且可能有副作用。

神经痛的其他治疗方法

您的医生可能会推荐其他疼痛治疗方法，包括

物理治疗可提高您的力量和平衡能力

Although these medicines can help with the pain, they do not change the nerve damage. Therefore, if there is no improvement with a medicine to treat pain, there is no benefit to continuing to take it and another medication may be tried.

All medicines have side effects. Ask your doctor about the side effects of any medicines you take. Doctors don’t recommend some medicines for older adults or for people with other health problems, such as heart disease.

Some doctors recommend avoiding over-the-counter pain medicines , such as acetaminophen and ibuprofen. These medicines may not work well for treating most nerve pain and can have side effects.

Other treatments for nerve pain

Your doctor may recommend other treatments for pain, including

physical therapy to improve your strength and balance

a bed cradle, a device that keeps sheets and blankets off your legs and feet while you sleep

title: 近端神经病变
content:
近端神经病变

在本节中：

什么是近端神经病变？

近端神经病变是一种罕见且致残的髋部、臀部或大腿神经损伤类型。这种类型的神经损伤通常会影响身体的一侧，很少会扩散到另一侧。

近端神经病变在男性中比在女性中更常见，并且在 50 岁以上的人群中更常见。大多数患有这种疾病的人患有 2 型糖尿病。

近端神经病变的原因是什么？

随着时间的推移，糖尿病引起的血液中的高血糖（也称为血糖）和高水平的脂肪（例如甘油三酯）会损害您的神经和滋养神经的小血管，导致近端神经病变。

近端神经病变有哪些症状？

症状可能包括

臀部、臀部或大腿突然疼痛，有时甚至剧烈疼痛

双腿无力，难以从坐姿站立

反射丧失，例如膝跳反射——当医生轻拍膝盖以下区域时小腿的自动运动

肌肉萎缩或肌肉组织损失

反射——当医生轻拍膝盖下方的区域时，小腿的自动运动

肌肉萎缩或肌肉组织损失

减肥

症状出现后，通常会变得更糟，然后在数月或数年内逐渐改善。在许多情况下，症状不会完全消失。

医生如何诊断近端神经病变？

医生通过询问您的症状并进行神经传导研究和肌电图 (EMG) 等测试来诊断近端神经病变。神经传导研究检查电信号通过身体不同部位神经的速度。肌电图显示您的肌肉对神经的反应。

我如何帮助治疗近端神经病变？

您可以通过控制糖尿病来帮助治疗近端神经病变，这意味着控制您的血糖、血压和胆固醇。

医生如何治疗近端神经病变？

您的医生可能会使用治疗周围神经病变疼痛的相同药物来治疗近端神经病变疼痛。

治疗近端神经病？

您的医生可能会使用治疗周围神经病变疼痛的相同药物来治疗近端神经病变疼痛。

您的医生可能还会建议物理治疗来帮助您增强力量，并建议进行职业治疗来帮助您进行日常活动。

即使不进行治疗，大多数人也会在几年内从近端神经病变中康复。

Proximal Neuropathy

In this section:

What is proximal neuropathy?

Proximal neuropathy is a rare and disabling type of nerve damage in your hip, buttock, or thigh. This type of nerve damage typically affects one side of your body and may rarely spread to the other side.

Proximal neuropathy is more common in men than in women and more common in people older than age 50. Most people with this condition have type 2 diabetes.

What causes proximal neuropathy?

Over time, high blood glucose, also called blood sugar, and high levels of fats, such as triglycerides , in the blood from diabetes can damage your nerves and the small blood vessels that nourish your nerves, leading to proximal neuropathy.

What are the symptoms of proximal neuropathy?

Symptoms may include

sudden and sometimes severe pain in your hip, buttock, or thigh

weakness in your legs that makes it difficult to stand from a sitting position

loss of reflexes such as the knee-jerk reflex—the automatic movement of your lower leg when a doctor taps the area below your knee cap

muscle wasting, or the loss of muscle tissue

您的医生可能会使用治疗周围神经病变疼痛的相同药物来治疗近端神经病变疼痛。
chunks.text_en:

muscle wasting, or the loss of muscle tissue

weight loss

After symptoms start, they typically get worse and then gradually improve over a period of months or years. In many cases, the symptoms do not go away completely.

How do doctors diagnose proximal neuropathy?

Doctors diagnose proximal neuropathy by asking about your symptoms and performing tests, such as nerve conduction studies and electromyography (EMG) . Nerve conduction studies check how fast electrical signals move through your nerves in different parts of your body. EMG shows how your muscles respond to your nerves.

How can I help treat proximal neuropathy?

You can help treat proximal neuropathy by managing your diabetes , which means managing your blood glucose, blood pressure, and cholesterol.

How do doctors treat proximal neuropathy?

Your doctor may treat the pain of proximal neuropathy with the same medicines used to treat peripheral neuropathy pain .

title: 什么是糖尿病神经病变？
content:
什么是糖尿病神经病变？

在本节中：

糖尿病神经病变是由糖尿病引起的神经损伤。

神经是一束特殊的组织，在大脑和身体其他部位之间传递信号。信号

糖尿病神经病变有哪些不同类型？

糖尿病神经病变的类型包括以下几种：

周围神经病变

周围神经病变是一种神经损伤，通常影响脚和腿，有时也会影响手和手臂。

自主神经病变

自主神经病变是控制内脏器官的神经受损。自主神经病变会导致心率和血压、消化系统、膀胱、性器官、汗腺、眼睛和低血糖感知能力出现问题。

局灶性神经病变

局灶性神经病是指单个神经通常受到损害的疾病，最常见的是手、头、躯干和腿。

近端神经病变

神经病是指单个神经受损的情况，最常见的是手、头、躯干和腿。

近端神经病变

近端神经病变是一种罕见且致残的髋部、臀部或大腿神经损伤类型。这种类型的神经损伤通常会影响身体的一侧，很少会扩散到另一侧。近端神经病变通常会引起剧烈疼痛，并可能导致体重显着下降。

谁最有可能患糖尿病神经病变？

如果您患有糖尿病，您的年龄越大，患糖尿病的时间越长，由糖尿病引起的神经损伤的机会就会增加。管理糖尿病是预防糖尿病神经病变等健康问题的重要组成部分。

超重

有高血压

有高胆固醇

患有晚期肾脏疾病

喝太多酒精饮料

抽烟

糖尿病神经病变的原因是什么？

还表明某些基因可能使人们更容易患糖尿病神经病变。

糖尿病神经病变的原因是什么？

随着时间的推移，糖尿病引起的血液中的高血糖水平（也称为血糖）和高脂肪水平（例如甘油三酯）会损害您的神经。高血糖水平还会损害为神经提供氧气和营养物质的小血管。没有足够的氧气和营养，你的神经就无法正常运作。

糖尿病神经病变有多常见？

尽管不同类型的糖尿病神经病变会影响糖尿病患者，但研究表明，多达一半的糖尿病患者患有周围神经病变。超过 30 百分比 的糖尿病患者患有自主神经病变。

最常见的局灶性神经病变类型是腕管综合征，即手腕的神经受到压迫。尽管只有不到 10 百分比 的糖尿病患者会出现腕管综合征症状，但大约 25 百分比 的糖尿病患者会出现手腕神经受压的情况。

的糖尿病患者感到腕管综合症的症状，大约 25 百分比 的糖尿病患者的手腕神经受到一定程度的压迫。

其他局灶性神经病和近端神经病不太常见。

糖尿病神经病变有哪些症状？

您的症状取决于您患有哪种类型的糖尿病神经病变。在周围神经病变中，有些人的脚可能会失去知觉，而另一些人的小腿可能会出现烧灼感或刺痛。大多数神经损伤会持续多年，有些人可能很长时间都没有注意到轻度神经损伤的症状。有些人会突然出现剧烈疼痛。

糖尿病神经病变会引起哪些问题？

周围神经病变可导致足部并发症，例如溃疡、溃疡和感染，因为神经损伤会使您的足部失去知觉。因此，您可能不会注意到鞋子引起疼痛或脚受伤。神经损伤还会导致平衡和协调问题，导致跌倒和骨折。

这些问题可能会让你难以轻松出行，导致你失去一些独立性。在一些糖尿病患者中，神经损伤会导致慢性疼痛，从而导致焦虑和抑郁。

自主神经病变可能会导致器官工作出现问题，包括心率和血压、消化、排尿以及低血糖感知能力的问题。

如何预防糖尿病性神经病变？

为了预防糖尿病性神经病变，通过控制血糖、血压和胆固醇水平来控制糖尿病非常重要。

您还应该采取以下步骤来帮助预防与糖尿病相关的神经损伤：

保持身体活跃

遵循您的糖尿病饮食计划

寻求戒烟帮助

将酒精饮料限制为女性每天不超过一杯，男性每天不超过两杯

膳食计划

寻求戒烟帮助

将酒精饮料限制为女性每天不超过一杯，男性每天不超过两杯

服用任何糖尿病药物和医生开的其他药物

如何预防糖尿病神经病变恶化？

如果您患有糖尿病神经病变，您应该控制糖尿病，这意味着控制您的血糖、血压、胆固醇水平和体重，以防止神经损伤恶化。

足部护理对于所有糖尿病患者都非常重要，如果您患有周围神经病变，则更重要。每天检查双脚是否有问题，并好好护理双脚。每年至少去看一次医生进行一次神经检查和足部检查——如果您有足部问题，则应更频繁地进行检查。

Peripheral neuropathy

Peripheral neuropathy is nerve damage that typically affects the feet and legs and sometimes affects the hands and arms.

Focal neuropathies are conditions in which you typically have damage to single nerves, most often in your hand, head, torso, and leg.

neuropathies are conditions in which you typically have damage to single nerves, most often in your hand, head, torso, and leg.

Proximal neuropathy

Proximal neuropathy is a rare and disabling type of nerve damage in your hip, buttock, or thigh. This type of nerve damage typically affects one side of your body and may rarely spread to the other side. Proximal neuropathy often causes severe pain and may lead to significant weight loss.

Who is most likely to get diabetic neuropathy?

If you have diabetes, your chance of developing nerve damage caused by diabetes increases the older you get and the longer you have diabetes. Managing your diabetes is an important part of preventing health problems such as diabetic neuropathy.

You are also more likely to develop nerve damage if you have diabetes and

are overweight

have high blood pressure

have high cholesterol

have advanced kidney disease

drink too many alcoholic drinks

smoke

Research also suggests that certain genes may make people more likely to develop diabetic neuropathy.

What causes diabetic neuropathy?

chunks.text_zh:
还表明某些基因可能使人们更容易患糖尿病神经病变。

糖尿病神经病变的原因是什么？

随着时间的推移，糖尿病引起的血液中的高血糖水平（也称为血糖）和高脂肪水平（例如甘油三酯）会损害您的神经。高血糖水平还会损害为神经提供氧气和营养物质的小血管。没有足够的氧气和营养，你的神经就无法正常运作。

糖尿病神经病变有多常见？

尽管不同类型的糖尿病神经病变会影响糖尿病患者，但研究表明，多达一半的糖尿病患者患有周围神经病变。超过 30 百分比 的糖尿病患者患有自主神经病变。

最常见的局灶性神经病变类型是腕管综合征，即手腕的神经受到压迫。尽管只有不到 10 百分比 的糖尿病患者会出现腕管综合征症状，但大约 25 百分比 的糖尿病患者会出现手腕神经受压的情况。
chunks.text_en:
also suggests that certain genes may make people more likely to develop diabetic neuropathy.

What causes diabetic neuropathy?

Over time, high blood glucose levels, also called blood sugar, and high levels of fats, such as triglycerides , in the blood from diabetes can damage your nerves. High blood glucose levels can also damage the small blood vessels that nourish your nerves with oxygen and nutrients. Without enough oxygen and nutrients, your nerves cannot function well.

How common is diabetic neuropathy?

Although different types of diabetic neuropathy can affect people who have diabetes, research suggests that up to one-half of people with diabetes have peripheral neuropathy. More than 30 percent of people with diabetes have autonomic neuropathy.

The most common type of focal neuropathy is carpal tunnel syndrome , in which a nerve in your wrist is compressed. Although less than 10 percent of people with diabetes feel symptoms of carpal tunnel syndrome, about 25 percent of people with diabetes have some nerve compression at the wrist.

chunks.text_zh:
的糖尿病患者感到腕管综合症的症状，大约 25 百分比 的糖尿病患者的手腕神经受到一定程度的压迫。

其他局灶性神经病和近端神经病不太常见。

糖尿病神经病变有哪些症状？

您的症状取决于您患有哪种类型的糖尿病神经病变。在周围神经病变中，有些人的脚可能会失去知觉，而另一些人的小腿可能会出现烧灼感或刺痛。大多数神经损伤会持续多年，有些人可能很长时间都没有注意到轻度神经损伤的症状。有些人会突然出现剧烈疼痛。

糖尿病神经病变会引起哪些问题？

周围神经病变可导致足部并发症，例如溃疡、溃疡和感染，因为神经损伤会使您的足部失去知觉。因此，您可能不会注意到鞋子引起疼痛或脚受伤。神经损伤还会导致平衡和协调问题，导致跌倒和骨折。
chunks.text_en:
of people with diabetes feel symptoms of carpal tunnel syndrome, about 25 percent of people with diabetes have some nerve compression at the wrist.

Other focal neuropathies and proximal neuropathy are less common.

What are the symptoms of diabetic neuropathy?

Your symptoms depend on which type of diabetic neuropathy you have. In peripheral neuropathy, some people may have a loss of sensation in their feet, while others may have burning or shooting pain in their lower legs. Most nerve damage develops over many years, and some people may not notice symptoms of mild nerve damage for a long time. In some people, severe pain begins suddenly.

What problems does diabetic neuropathy cause?

Peripheral neuropathy can lead to foot complications , such as sores, ulcers, and infections, because nerve damage can make you lose feeling in your feet. As a result, you may not notice that your shoes are causing a sore or that you have injured your feet. Nerve damage can also cause problems with balance and coordination, leading to falls and fractures.

chunks.text_zh:
疼痛或您的脚受伤了。神经损伤还会导致平衡和协调问题，导致跌倒和骨折。

这些问题可能会让你难以轻松出行，导致你失去一些独立性。在一些糖尿病患者中，神经损伤会导致慢性疼痛，从而导致焦虑和抑郁。

自主神经病变可能会导致器官工作出现问题，包括心率和血压、消化、排尿以及低血糖感知能力的问题。

如何预防糖尿病性神经病变？

为了预防糖尿病性神经病变，通过控制血糖、血压和胆固醇水平来控制糖尿病非常重要。

您还应该采取以下步骤来帮助预防与糖尿病相关的神经损伤：

保持身体活跃

遵循您的糖尿病饮食计划

寻求戒烟帮助

将酒精饮料限制为女性每天不超过一杯，男性每天不超过两杯
chunks.text_en:
a sore or that you have injured your feet. Nerve damage can also cause problems with balance and coordination, leading to falls and fractures.

These problems may make it difficult for you to get around easily, causing you to lose some of your independence. In some people with diabetes, nerve damage causes chronic pain, which can lead to anxiety and depression .

Autonomic neuropathy can cause problems with how your organs work , including problems with your heart rate and blood pressure, digestion, urination , and ability to sense when you have low blood glucose.

How can I prevent diabetic neuropathy?

To prevent diabetic neuropathy, it is important to manage your diabetes by managing your blood glucose, blood pressure, and cholesterol levels.

You should also take the following steps to help prevent diabetes-related nerve damage:

be physically active

follow your diabetes meal plan

get help to quit smoking

limit alcoholic drinks to no more than one drink per day for women and no more than two drinks per day for men

chunks.text_zh:
膳食计划

寻求戒烟帮助

将酒精饮料限制为女性每天不超过一杯，男性每天不超过两杯

服用任何糖尿病药物和医生开的其他药物

如何预防糖尿病神经病变恶化？

如果您患有糖尿病神经病变，您应该控制糖尿病，这意味着控制您的血糖、血压、胆固醇水平和体重，以防止神经损伤恶化。

足部护理对于所有糖尿病患者都非常重要，如果您患有周围神经病变，则更重要。每天检查双脚是否有问题，并好好护理双脚。每年至少去看一次医生进行一次神经检查和足部检查——如果您有足部问题，则应更频繁地进行检查。
chunks.text_en:
meal plan

get help to quit smoking

limit alcoholic drinks to no more than one drink per day for women and no more than two drinks per day for men

take any diabetes medicines and other medicines your doctor prescribes

How can I prevent diabetic neuropathy from getting worse?

If you have diabetic neuropathy, you should manage your diabetes, which means managing your blood glucose, blood pressure, cholesterol levels, and weight to keep nerve damage from getting worse.

Foot care is very important for all people with diabetes, and it’s even more important if you have peripheral neuropathy. Check your feet for problems every day, and take good care of your feet . See your doctor for a neurological exam and a foot exam at least once a year—more often if you have foot problems.

title: 糖尿病、性和膀胱问题
content:
糖尿病、性和膀胱问题

在本节中：

随着人们年龄的增长，性问题和膀胱问题很常见，但糖尿病会使这些问题变得更糟。您或您的伴侣可能在性生活或享受性生活方面遇到困难。或者，您可能会漏尿或无法正常排空膀胱。

高血糖（也称为血糖）可能会损害血管和神经。这种损害可能导致性和膀胱问题。将血糖水平保持在目标范围内是防止血管和神经受损的重要方法。

与您的医疗团队合作，帮助预防或治疗性和膀胱问题。这些问题可能表明您需要以不同的方式控制糖尿病。请记住，健康的性生活和健康的膀胱可以提高您的生活质量，因此如果您有疑虑，请立即采取行动。

性和膀胱问题可能是糖尿病的症状吗？

健康的膀胱可以提高您的生活质量，因此如果您有疑虑，请立即采取行动。

性和膀胱问题可能是糖尿病的症状吗？

是的。性功能或膀胱习惯的变化可能是您患有糖尿病的征兆。糖尿病引起的神经损伤（也称为糖尿病神经病变）会损害您身体的某些部位，例如生殖器或泌尿道。例如，患有糖尿病的男性可能比没有糖尿病的男性早 10 到 15 几年出现勃起功能障碍 (ED)。

如果您有任何糖尿病症状，包括性和膀胱问题，请咨询医疗保健专业人员。

我什么时候应该就性或膀胱问题去看医生？

如果出现性或膀胱问题，请咨询医疗保健专业人员。这些问题可能表明您需要以不同的方式管理糖尿病。您可能会发现谈论这些事情很尴尬且困难。然而，请记住，医疗保健专业人员接受过与人们谈论各种健康问题的培训。每个人都应该拥有健康的人际关系并享受他们喜欢的活动。

接受过与人们谈论各种健康问题的培训。每个人都应该拥有健康的人际关系并享受他们喜欢的活动。

是什么让我更容易出现性或膀胱问题

如果您患有糖尿病并且

血糖控制不佳，也称为高血糖

有神经损伤，也称为神经病

患有未治疗的高血压

患有未治疗的高胆固醇

超重或肥胖

身体不活跃

正在服用某些药物

喝太多酒精饮料

抽烟

研究还表明，某些基因可能使人们更容易患糖尿病神经病变。

男性糖尿病患者会出现哪些性问题？

糖尿病期间血管、神经、激素和情绪健康的变化可能会使您更难获得满意的性生活。糖尿病及其相关挑战也可能使您更难生育。

勃起功能障碍

为您带来满意的性爱。糖尿病及其相关挑战也可能使您更难生育。

勃起功能障碍

如果您无法勃起或保持足够坚挺以进行满意的性交，则您患有 ED。超过一半的糖尿病男性会患上 ED。患有糖尿病的男性患 ED 的可能性是未患有糖尿病的男性的 3 倍以上。良好的糖尿病管理可能有助于预防和治疗由神经损伤和循环问题引起的 ED。医生可以通过药物或改变您的糖尿病护理计划来帮助治疗 ED。

逆行射精

在极少数情况下，糖尿病会导致逆行射精，即在射精期间部分或全部精液进入膀胱而不是从阴茎流出。在逆行射精期间，精液进入膀胱，与尿液混合，然后安全地排出体外。射精后的尿液样本可以显示您是否有逆行射精。有些患有逆行射精的男性可能根本不射精。

阴茎弯曲

射精后可以显示您是否有逆行射精。有些患有逆行射精的男性可能根本不射精。

阴茎弯曲

患有糖尿病的男性比没有糖尿病的男性更有可能患有佩罗尼氏病，也称为阴茎弯曲。患有佩罗尼氏病的男性阴茎上有疤痕组织，称为斑块，使其在勃起时弯曲。阴茎的弯曲会使性交疼痛或困难。一些患有佩罗尼氏病的男性可能患有 ED。

睾酮水平低

男性的睾酮水平随着年龄的增长而自然降低。然而，低于正常水平的睾酮水平可能是一些男性 ED 的原因，或者可以解释为什么一些男性经常感到疲倦、抑郁或性欲低下。患有糖尿病的男性，尤其是年龄较大和超重的男性，更有可能出现低睾酮水平，或“低 T”。

，或性欲低下。患有糖尿病的男性，尤其是年龄较大和超重的男性，更有可能出现低睾酮水平，或“低 T”。

如果您的医生认为您的 T 值可能较低，您可能会被要求提供血液样本，并且医疗保健专业人员将为您进行体检。您的医生可能会建议您使用处方凝胶、注射剂或贴剂来治疗睾酮水平低下。

多项研究表明，除了良好的糖尿病管理外，睾酮疗法还可以减轻男性的性问题。然而，睾酮疗法可能存在严重风险，并且可能并不对所有男性都安全。与您的医生讨论睾酮疗法的副作用以及它是否适合您。

生育问题

一些研究表明，患有糖尿病的男性的精子可能会出现问题，从而使其更难受孕。您的精子可能运行缓慢或移动不良，或者您的精子可能无法使女性的卵子受精。与您的伴侣和接受过生育问题培训的医疗保健专业人员密切合作可能会有所帮助。

无法使女性的卵子良好受精。与您的伴侣和接受过生育问题培训的医疗保健专业人员密切合作可能会有所帮助。

如果您和您的伴侣想要怀孕，您的医生可能会用药物或改变您的糖尿病护理计划来治疗糖尿病引起的逆行射精。或者，与生育专家泌尿科医生交谈。他或她也许能够从您的尿液中收集您的精子，然后将其用于人工授精。

患有糖尿病的女性会出现哪些性问题？

神经损伤、流向生殖器的血流减少以及荷尔蒙变化可能导致性欲和反应低下、阴道干燥和性交疼痛。其他情况也可能导致这些问题，包括更年期。如果您发现性生活发生变化，请与您的医疗保健团队交谈。体检（包括骨盆检查、血液和尿液检查）可能会帮助您的医生找到问题的原因。

性欲和反应低下

性欲和性反应低下可能包括

无法变得或保持兴奋

你的问题的原因。

性欲和反应低下

性欲和性反应低下可能包括

无法变得或保持兴奋

阴道润滑不足

生殖器几乎没有感觉

无法达到性高潮或很少达到性高潮

患有糖尿病，您的身体和思想可能会发生许多变化。例如，高血糖和低血糖水平都会影响您如何以及是否被唤醒。或者，您可能会发现自己比平常更疲倦或沮丧和焦虑，从而使您对性不感兴趣。

您的医疗保健团队可以帮助您更改糖尿病护理计划，使您重回正轨。将血糖水平保持在目标范围内的女性不太可能出现神经损伤，从而导致性欲和反应低下。

痛苦的性爱

将血糖水平保持在目标范围内不太可能出现神经损伤，从而导致性欲和反应低下。

痛苦的性爱

一些患有糖尿病的女性表示她们的性交不舒服或疼痛。在刺激过程中告诉阴道润滑的神经可能会因糖尿病而受损。如果您阴道干燥，处方药或非处方阴道润滑剂可能会有所帮助。在数周、数月甚至数年内良好地管理血糖有助于预防神经损伤。

酵母菌和膀胱感染

患有糖尿病的女性更容易感染酵母菌，因为当您的血糖水平较高时，酵母菌更容易生长。酵母菌感染可能会让人感到不舒服或疼痛，并妨碍您享受活动，包括性行为。

尽管某些酵母菌感染可以在家治疗，但请先与医疗保健专业人员讨论您的症状。酵母菌感染的一些症状与其他类型的感染相似，包括性传播疾病。

怀孕问题和生育问题

酵母菌感染与其他类型的感染相似，包括性传播疾病。

怀孕问题和生育问题

如果您患有糖尿病并计划怀孕，那么在怀孕前让您的血糖水平接近目标范围非常重要。高血糖可能会在怀孕的头几周伤害您的宝宝，甚至在您知道自己怀孕之前。

如果您患有糖尿病并且已经怀孕，请尽快去看医生以制定控制糖尿病的计划。与您的医疗保健团队合作并遵循您的糖尿病管理计划可以帮助您拥有健康的怀孕和健康的婴儿。

与糖尿病相关的肥胖和多囊卵巢综合症 (PCOS) 等健康问题可能会导致怀孕更加困难。如果您在怀孕期间遇到问题，请咨询医疗保健专业人士，例如妇科医生或生育专家。

患有糖尿病的男性和女性会出现哪些膀胱问题？

如果您在怀孕方面遇到问题，请咨询妇科医生或生育专家。

患有糖尿病的男性和女性会出现哪些膀胱问题？

糖尿病会导致泌尿道神经损伤，导致膀胱问题。超重和肥胖还会增加膀胱问题，例如尿失禁 (UI)。控制糖尿病是预防可能导致排尿过多的问题的重要组成部分。

如果需要，您的医疗保健团队也许能够帮助您管理血糖水平并帮助您减肥。医生使用血液和尿液检查来诊断膀胱问题或具有类似症状的病症。医生还可能使用尿动力学测试来了解您患有哪种膀胱问题。

尿频、尿急

一些经常出现高血糖的糖尿病患者可能需要经常排尿，也称为尿频。即使患有糖尿病的男性和女性将血糖水平控制在目标范围内，有时也会突然感到想要排尿，称为急迫性尿失禁。这种情况也可能发生在晚上。药物可能有助于减轻膀胱控制问题的症状。

尿急，称为急迫性尿失禁。这种情况也可能发生在晚上。药物可能有助于减轻膀胱控制问题的症状。

麻烦“走”

您可能会发现糖尿病导致您不再有膀胱充盈的感觉。许多糖尿病患者报告称他们“行走”有困难。随着时间的推移，膀胱过满会对膀胱肌肉造成损伤，从而将尿液排出。当这些肌肉无法正常工作时，尿液可能会在膀胱中停留太久，也称为尿潴留。尿潴留会导致膀胱感染、漏尿以及总有尿意的感觉。

漏尿

糖尿病患者更有可能患有其他类型的尿失禁，例如压力性尿失禁。与糖尿病相关的神经损伤、肥胖和膀胱感染通常与膀胱控制问题有关。漏尿可能会导致您避免曾经喜欢的活动，包括性行为。

与糖尿病有关的，通常与膀胱控制问题有关。漏尿会导致您避免曾经喜欢的活动，包括性行为。

如果您超重，减肥可以帮助您减少漏尿。避免体重增加可能会预防 UI。研究表明，随着您的体重指数 (BMI) 增加，您更容易漏尿。如果您超重或肥胖，请与您的医生讨论如何减肥。

与您的医疗团队合作，帮助管理和防止尿液泄漏。膀胱控制问题通常是可以治疗的，而且很常见，即使在没有糖尿病的人中也是如此。您不必总是冲去卫生间以避免漏水。

膀胱感染

糖尿病患者更容易患有尿路感染，也称为膀胱感染或膀胱炎。如果您尿频、尿急并且可能会感到疼痛，请立即就医。膀胱感染可发展为​​肾脏感染，并使膀胱症状（例如漏尿和尿潴留）变得更严重。此外，膀胱感染还会妨碍您的日常生活，包括亲密关系。管理血糖水平有助于预防膀胱感染。

如何预防和治疗性或膀胱问题？

管理糖尿病可以帮助预防神经损伤和其他可能导致性和膀胱问题的糖尿病问题。在您的医疗团队的帮助下，您可以通过以下方式帮助预防和治疗您的性或膀胱控制问题：

让您的血糖、血压和胆固醇水平接近目标值

身体活跃

保持健康的体重

如果您吸烟，请戒烟

就任何情绪或心理问题寻求帮助

性爱是一项体力活动，因此请务必在性爱前后检查您的血糖水平，尤其是在服用胰岛素的情况下。高血糖水平和低血糖水平都会在性行为中引起问题。

当您注意到性功能或性欲发生变化时，咨询也可能会有所帮助。随着人们年龄的增长或适应健康问题，这些类型的变化非常常见。

如果您有伴侣，他或她也可能是您的医疗保健团队的重要成员。您可能会发现分享您的担忧并让那个人与您一起去医生办公室或接受咨询会很有帮助。如果您有膀胱问题，您的朋友和家人也可能能够为您提供支持。

Diabetes, Sexual, & Bladder Problems

In this section:

Sexual problems and bladder problems are common as people age, but diabetes can make these problems worse. You or your partner may have trouble having or enjoying sex. Or, you may leak urine or have trouble emptying your bladder normally.

Blood vessels and nerves can be damaged by the effects of high blood glucose , also called blood sugar. This damage can lead to sexual and bladder problems. Keeping your blood glucose levels in your target range is an important way to prevent damage to your blood vessels and nerves.

Work with your health care team to help prevent or treat sexual and bladder problems . These problems may be signs that you need to manage your diabetes in a different way. Remember, a healthy sex life and a healthy bladder can improve your quality of life, so take action now if you have concerns.

Can sexual and bladder problems be symptoms of diabetes?

chunks.text_zh:

性和膀胱问题可能是糖尿病的症状吗？

是的。性功能或膀胱习惯的变化可能是您患有糖尿病的征兆。糖尿病引起的神经损伤（也称为糖尿病神经病变）会损害您身体的某些部位，例如生殖器或泌尿道。例如，患有糖尿病的男性可能比没有糖尿病的男性早 10 到 15 几年出现勃起功能障碍 (ED)。

如果您有任何糖尿病症状，包括性和膀胱问题，请咨询医疗保健专业人员。

我什么时候应该就性或膀胱问题去看医生？

如果出现性或膀胱问题，请咨询医疗保健专业人员。这些问题可能表明您需要以不同的方式管理糖尿病。您可能会发现谈论这些事情很尴尬且困难。然而，请记住，医疗保健专业人员接受过与人们谈论各种健康问题的培训。每个人都应该拥有健康的人际关系并享受他们喜欢的活动。

Can sexual and bladder problems be symptoms of diabetes?

Yes. Changes in sexual function or bladder habits may be a sign that you have diabetes. Nerve damage caused by diabetes, also called diabetic neuropathy , can damage parts of your body—like your genitals or urinary tract. For example, men with diabetes may develop erectile dysfunction (ED) 10 to 15 years earlier than men without diabetes.

Talk with a health care professional if you have any symptoms of diabetes , including sexual and bladder problems.

When should I see a doctor about my sexual or bladder problems?

See a health care professional for problems with sex or your bladder. These problems could be a sign that you need to manage your diabetes differently. You may find it embarrassing and difficult to talk about these things. However, remember that health care professionals are trained to speak with people about every kind of health problem. Everyone deserves to have healthy relationships and enjoy the activities they love.

What makes me more likely to develop sexual or bladder problems

You’re more likely to develop sexual or bladder problems if you have diabetes and

have high blood glucose that is not well controlled, also called high blood sugar

have nerve damage, also called neuropathy

have high blood pressure that is not treated

have high cholesterol that is not treated

are overweight or have obesity

are not physically active

are taking certain medicines

drink too many alcoholic drinks

smoke

Research also suggests that certain genes may make people more likely to develop diabetic neuropathy.

What sexual problems can men with diabetes have?

Changes in your blood vessels, nerves, hormones , and emotional health during diabetes may make it more difficult for you to have satisfactory sex. Diabetes and its related challenges also may make it harder for you to have a child.

Erectile dysfunction

You have ED if you’re unable to get or keep an erection firm enough for satisfactory sexual intercourse. More than half of men with diabetes will get ED. Men who have diabetes are more than 3 times more likely to develop ED than men who do not have diabetes. Good diabetes management may help prevent and treat ED caused by nerve damage and circulation problems. A doctor can help treat ED with medicine or a change in your diabetes care plan.

Retrograde ejaculation

Rarely, diabetes can cause retrograde ejaculation , which is when part or all of your semen goes into your bladder instead of out of your penis during ejaculation. During retrograde ejaculation, semen enters your bladder, mixes with urine, and is safely urinated out. A urine sample after ejaculation can show if you have retrograde ejaculation. Some men with retrograde ejaculation may not ejaculate at all.

Penile curvature

Penile curvature

Men with diabetes are more likely to have Peyronie’s disease , also called penile curvature, than men who don’t have diabetes. Men with Peyronie’s disease have scar tissue, called a plaque, in the penis, making it curve when erect. Curves in the penis can make sexual intercourse painful or difficult. Some men with Peyronie’s disease may have ED.

Low testosterone

Men’s testosterone levels naturally lower with age. However, lower-than-normal testosterone levels may be the cause of some men’s ED, or can explain why some men often feel tired, depressed , or have a low sex drive. Men with diabetes, especially those who are older and overweight, are more likely to have low testosterone , or “low T.”

Fertility problems

Some studies show that men with diabetes can have problems with their sperm that make it harder to conceive. Your sperm could be slow or not move well, or your sperm may not be able to fertilize a woman’s egg well. Working closely with your partner and a health care professional trained in fertility issues may help.

If you and your partner want to conceive a child, your doctor may treat retrograde ejaculation caused by diabetes with medicine or by changing your diabetes care plan. Or, talk with a urologist who is a fertility expert. He or she may be able to collect your sperm from your urine and then use it for artificial insemination .

What sexual problems can women with diabetes have?

Low sexual desire and response, vaginal dryness, and painful sex can be caused by nerve damage, reduced blood flow to the genitals, and hormonal changes. Other conditions can cause these problems, too, including menopause . If you notice a change in your sex life, talk with your health care team. A physical exam, which will include a pelvic exam , and blood and urine tests may help your doctor find the cause of your problems.

Painful sex

Some women with diabetes say they have uncomfortable or painful sexual intercourse. The nerves that tell your vagina to lubricate during stimulation can become damaged by diabetes. A prescription or over-the-counter vaginal lubricant may help if you have vaginal dryness. Managing your blood glucose well over many weeks, months, and years can help prevent nerve damage.

Yeast and bladder infections

Women with diabetes are more likely to have yeast infections , because yeast organisms can grow more easily when your blood glucose levels are higher. Yeast infections can be uncomfortable or painful and prevent you from enjoying activities, including having sex.

Although some yeast infections can be treated at home, talk with a health care professional first about your symptoms. Some symptoms of yeast infections are similar to other types of infections, including sexually transmitted diseases.

Pregnancy concerns and fertility problems

怀孕问题和生育问题

如果您患有糖尿病并计划怀孕，那么在怀孕前让您的血糖水平接近目标范围非常重要。高血糖可能会在怀孕的头几周伤害您的宝宝，甚至在您知道自己怀孕之前。

如果您患有糖尿病并且已经怀孕，请尽快去看医生以制定控制糖尿病的计划。与您的医疗保健团队合作并遵循您的糖尿病管理计划可以帮助您拥有健康的怀孕和健康的婴儿。

与糖尿病相关的肥胖和多囊卵巢综合症 (PCOS) 等健康问题可能会导致怀孕更加困难。如果您在怀孕期间遇到问题，请咨询医疗保健专业人士，例如妇科医生或生育专家。

Pregnancy concerns and fertility problems

If you have diabetes and plan to become pregnant , it’s important to get your blood glucose levels close to your target range before you get pregnant. High blood glucose can harm your baby during the first weeks of pregnancy, even before you know you’re pregnant.

If you have diabetes and are already pregnant, see your doctor as soon as possible to make a plan to manage your diabetes. Working with your health care team and following your diabetes management plan can help you have a healthy pregnancy and a healthy baby.

Health problems such as obesity and polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) that are linked to diabetes can make it harder to conceive a child. Talk with a health care professional, such as a gynecologist or a fertility specialist, if you’re having problems conceiving a child.

What bladder problems can men and women with diabetes have?

如果您在怀孕方面遇到问题，请咨询妇科医生或生育专家。

患有糖尿病的男性和女性会出现哪些膀胱问题？

糖尿病会导致泌尿道神经损伤，导致膀胱问题。超重和肥胖还会增加膀胱问题，例如尿失禁 (UI)。控制糖尿病是预防可能导致排尿过多的问题的重要组成部分。

如果需要，您的医疗保健团队也许能够帮助您管理血糖水平并帮助您减肥。医生使用血液和尿液检查来诊断膀胱问题或具有类似症状的病症。医生还可能使用尿动力学测试来了解您患有哪种膀胱问题。

尿频、尿急

一些经常出现高血糖的糖尿病患者可能需要经常排尿，也称为尿频。即使患有糖尿病的男性和女性将血糖水平控制在目标范围内，有时也会突然感到想要排尿，称为急迫性尿失禁。这种情况也可能发生在晚上。药物可能有助于减轻膀胱控制问题的症状。
chunks.text_en:
a gynecologist or a fertility specialist, if you’re having problems conceiving a child.

What bladder problems can men and women with diabetes have?

Diabetes can cause nerve damage to your urinary tract , causing bladder problems. Overweight and obesity also can increase bladder problems, such as urinary incontinence (UI) . Managing diabetes is an important part of preventing problems that can lead to excess urination.

Your health care team may be able to help you manage your blood glucose levels and help you lose weight , if needed. Doctors use blood and urine tests to diagnose bladder problems or conditions with similar symptoms. Doctors also may use urodynamic testing to see what kind of bladder problem you have.

Frequent and urgent urination

Some people with diabetes who regularly have high blood glucose levels may have to urinate too often, also called urinary frequency . Even men and women with diabetes who manage their blood glucose levels within their target range sometimes feel the sudden urge to urinate, called urgency incontinence . This can happen at night, also. Medicines may help reduce the symptoms of bladder control problems.

chunks.text_zh:
尿急，称为急迫性尿失禁。这种情况也可能发生在晚上。药物可能有助于减轻膀胱控制问题的症状。

麻烦“走”

您可能会发现糖尿病导致您不再有膀胱充盈的感觉。许多糖尿病患者报告称他们“行走”有困难。随着时间的推移，膀胱过满会对膀胱肌肉造成损伤，从而将尿液排出。当这些肌肉无法正常工作时，尿液可能会在膀胱中停留太久，也称为尿潴留。尿潴留会导致膀胱感染、漏尿以及总有尿意的感觉。

漏尿

糖尿病患者更有可能患有其他类型的尿失禁，例如压力性尿失禁。与糖尿病相关的神经损伤、肥胖和膀胱感染通常与膀胱控制问题有关。漏尿可能会导致您避免曾经喜欢的活动，包括性行为。
chunks.text_en:
urge to urinate, called urgency incontinence . This can happen at night, also. Medicines may help reduce the symptoms of bladder control problems.

Trouble “going”

You may find that diabetes causes you to no longer feel when your bladder is full. Many people with diabetes report that they have trouble “going.” Over time, having a too-full bladder can cause damage to your bladder muscles that push urine out. When these muscles don’t work correctly, urine may stay in your bladder too long, also called urinary retention . Urinary retention can cause bladder infections, urine leaks, and the feeling that you always have to go.

Leaking urine

People with diabetes are more likely to have other types of UI, such as stress incontinence . Nerve damage , obesity, and bladder infections, which are linked with diabetes, are often related to bladder control problems. Leaking urine can cause you to avoid activities you once enjoyed, including sex.

chunks.text_zh:
与糖尿病有关的，通常与膀胱控制问题有关。漏尿会导致您避免曾经喜欢的活动，包括性行为。

如果您超重，减肥可以帮助您减少漏尿。避免体重增加可能会预防 UI。研究表明，随着您的体重指数 (BMI) 增加，您更容易漏尿。如果您超重或肥胖，请与您的医生讨论如何减肥。

与您的医疗团队合作，帮助管理和防止尿液泄漏。膀胱控制问题通常是可以治疗的，而且很常见，即使在没有糖尿病的人中也是如此。您不必总是冲去卫生间以避免漏水。

膀胱感染

糖尿病患者更容易患有尿路感染，也称为膀胱感染或膀胱炎。如果您尿频、尿急并且可能会感到疼痛，请立即就医。膀胱感染可发展为​​肾脏感染，并使膀胱症状（例如漏尿和尿潴留）变得更严重。此外，膀胱感染还会妨碍您的日常生活，包括亲密关系。管理血糖水平有助于预防膀胱感染。
chunks.text_en:
linked with diabetes, are often related to bladder control problems. Leaking urine can cause you to avoid activities you once enjoyed, including sex.

If you’re overweight, losing weight can help you have fewer leaks. Avoiding weight gain may prevent UI. Studies suggest that, as your body mass index (BMI) increases, you’re more likely to leak. If you’re overweight or have obesity, talk with your doctor about how to lose weight .

Work with your health care team to help manage and prevent urine leaks. Bladder control problems are often treatable and are very common, even in people who don’t have diabetes. You don’t have to accept rushing to the bathroom all the time to avoid leaks.

Bladder infections

People with diabetes are more likely to have urinary tract infections, also called bladder infections , or cystitis . See a doctor right away if you have frequent, urgent urination that may be painful. Bladder infections can develop into kidney infections and can make bladder symptoms, such as leaks and urine retention, worse. Also, bladder infections can get in the way of your everyday life, including intimacy. Managing your blood glucose levels can help prevent bladder infections.

chunks.text_zh:
感染可能会妨碍您的日常生活，包括亲密关系。管理血糖水平有助于预防膀胱感染。

如何预防和治疗性或膀胱问题？

管理糖尿病可以帮助预防神经损伤和其他可能导致性和膀胱问题的糖尿病问题。在您的医疗团队的帮助下，您可以通过以下方式帮助预防和治疗您的性或膀胱控制问题：

让您的血糖、血压和胆固醇水平接近目标值

身体活跃

保持健康的体重

如果您吸烟，请戒烟

就任何情绪或心理问题寻求帮助

性爱是一项体力活动，因此请务必在性爱前后检查您的血糖水平，尤其是在服用胰岛素的情况下。高血糖水平和低血糖水平都会在性行为中引起问题。

当您注意到性功能或性欲发生变化时，咨询也可能会有所帮助。随着人们年龄的增长或适应健康问题，这些类型的变化非常常见。
chunks.text_en:
infections can get in the way of your everyday life, including intimacy. Managing your blood glucose levels can help prevent bladder infections.

How can I prevent and treat my sexual or bladder problems?

Managing your diabetes can help prevent nerve damage and other diabetes problems that can lead to sexual and bladder problems. With your health care team, you can help prevent and treat your sexual or bladder control problems by

keeping your blood glucose, blood pressure, and cholesterol levels close to your target numbers

being physically active

keeping a healthy weight

quitting smoking if you smoke

getting help for any emotional or psychological problems

Sex is a physical activity, so be sure to check your blood glucose level before and after sex, especially if you take insulin . Both high blood glucose levels and low blood glucose levels can cause problems during sex.

Counseling may also be helpful when you notice changes in your sexual function or desire. These types of changes are very common as people age or adjust to health problems.

chunks.text_zh:
当您注意到性功能或性欲发生变化时会很有帮助。随着人们年龄的增长或适应健康问题，这些类型的变化非常常见。

如果您有伴侣，他或她也可能是您的医疗保健团队的重要成员。您可能会发现分享您的担忧并让那个人与您一起去医生办公室或接受咨询会很有帮助。如果您有膀胱问题，您的朋友和家人也可能能够为您提供支持。
chunks.text_en:
helpful when you notice changes in your sexual function or desire. These types of changes are very common as people age or adjust to health problems.

If you have a partner, he or she also may be an important member of your health care team. You may find it helpful to share your concerns and have that person join you at the doctor’s office or at counseling. Your friends and family may also be able to support you if you’re having bladder problems.

title: 糖尿病、心脏病和中风
content:
糖尿病、心脏病和中风

在此页面上：

患有糖尿病意味着您更容易患心脏病。糖尿病患者也更有可能存在某些危险因素，例如高血压或高胆固醇，这些因素会增加心脏病发作或中风的风险。

如果您患有糖尿病，您可以通过管理血糖（也称为血糖）来保护您的心脏和健康。您还可以通过控制高血压和高胆固醇来保护自己。如果您吸烟，请寻求帮助来戒烟。

糖尿病、心脏病和中风之间有什么联系？

糖尿病引起的高血糖会损害您的血管以及控制心脏和血管的神经。随着时间的推移，这种损害会导致心脏病。

与未患糖尿病的人相比，糖尿病患者患心脏病的年龄往往更年轻。患有糖尿病的成年人患心脏病或中风的可能性几乎是没有糖尿病的成年人的两倍。

比没有糖尿病的人更年轻。患有糖尿病的成年人患心脏病或中风的可能性几乎是没有糖尿病的成年人的两倍。

好消息是，您采取的控制糖尿病的措施也有助于降低患心脏病或中风的机会。

如果我患有糖尿病，还有什么会增加我患心脏病或中风的风险？

如果您是男性而不是女性，无论您是否患有糖尿病，患心脏病的风险都会更大。如果您确实患有糖尿病，其他因素会增加您患心脏病或中风的风险。

吸烟

吸烟会增加患心脏病的风险。如果您患有糖尿病，戒烟很重要，因为吸烟和糖尿病都会使血管收缩。吸烟还会增加出现其他长期问题的机会，例如

肺部疾病

小腿感染和溃疡

足或腿截肢

高血压

出现其他长期问题的可能性，例如

肺部疾病

小腿感染和溃疡

足或腿截肢

高血压

如果您患有高血压，您的心脏会更加努力地泵血。高血压会使心脏紧张、损害血管，并增加心脏病发作、中风以及眼睛或肾脏问题的风险。定期检查血压并与医生合作控制或降低高血压。

胆固醇水平异常

胆固醇是一种脂肪，由肝脏产生并存在于血液中。您的血液中有两种胆固醇：低密度脂蛋白和高密度脂蛋白。

低密度脂蛋白，通常被称为“坏”胆固醇，会积聚并堵塞血管。高水平的低密度脂蛋白胆固醇会增加患心脏病的风险。 HDL 有时被称为“好胆固醇”。高密度脂蛋白水平越高，患心脏病和中风的风险就越低。要提高低密度脂蛋白和高密度脂蛋白水平，请限制饮食计划中的脂肪含量，多吃植物性食物，并定期进行体育锻炼。

中风。要提高低密度脂蛋白和高密度脂蛋白水平，请限制饮食计划中的脂肪含量，多吃植物性食物，并定期进行体育锻炼。

另一种血脂甘油三酯，当其水平高于医疗团队建议的水平时，也会增加患心脏病的风险。

肥胖和腹部脂肪

超重或肥胖会使控制糖尿病变得更加困难，并增加患许多健康问题的风险，包括心脏病和高血压。如果您超重，热量较少、体力活动较多的健康饮食计划通常会降低您的血糖水平并减少对药物的需求。

即使您没有超重，腰部过多的腹部脂肪也会增加患心脏病的风险。

如果您测量腰围，则表明腹部脂肪过多

超过 40 英寸，你是一个男人

超过 35 英寸，您是女性

慢性肾脏病

如果您的腰围测量有多余的腹部脂肪

超过 40 英寸，你是一个男人

超过 35 英寸，您是女性

慢性肾脏病

心脏病与慢性肾脏病密切相关，慢性肾脏病会导致肾脏受损，无法正常过滤血液。患有糖尿病是患肾脏疾病的危险因素，影响约 40% 的糖尿病患者。患肾病的其他危险因素是高血压和肾衰竭家族史。

如果您有危险因素，请接受肾脏疾病检测，并通过选择健康的食物、更加活跃、争取健康的体重以及管理导致肾脏损害的健康状况来保护您的肾脏。

心脏病家族史

心脏病家族史可能会增加患心脏病的机会。如果您的一名或多名家庭成员在 50 岁之前患有心脏病，那么您患心脏病的几率是没有家族病史的人的两倍。

在 50 岁之前心脏病发作，与没有心脏病家族史的人相比，您患心脏病的几率是双倍。

你无法改变你的家族是否患有心脏病。但如果您患有糖尿病，采取措施保护自己免受心脏病并减少中风的机会就更为重要。

如果我患有糖尿病，如何降低心脏病发作或中风的风险？

照顾您的糖尿病对于帮助您保护心脏非常重要。通过采取以下步骤来保持心脏和血管健康，您可以大大降低心脏病发作或中风的几率。

管理您的糖尿病 ABC

了解糖尿病基础知识可以帮助您管理血糖、血压和胆固醇。如果您患有糖尿病，请停止吸烟，以降低患心脏病的机会。

A代表A1C测试

血糖、血压和胆固醇。如果您患有糖尿病，请停止吸烟，以降低患心脏病的机会。

A代表A1C测试

A1C 测试显示您过去 3 个月的平均血糖水平。这与您每天进行的血糖检查不同。您的 A1C 值越高，您在过去 3 个月内的血糖水平就越高。高血糖会损害您的心脏、血管、肾脏、脚和眼睛。

许多糖尿病患者的 A1C 目标低于 7%。有些人的 A1C 目标可能会稍高一些，效果会更好。随着年龄的增长和生活方式的改变，您的 A1C 目标也可能会发生变化。询问您的医疗保健团队您的目标应该是什么。

B是血压

血压是血液对血管壁的压力。如果你的血压太高，你的心脏就会过度劳累。高血压会导致心脏病或中风，并损害肾脏和眼睛。

压力太大，会让你的心脏工作太辛苦。高血压会导致心脏病或中风，并损害肾脏和眼睛。

大多数糖尿病患者的血压目标低于 140/90 毫米汞柱。询问你的目标应该是什么。

C代表胆固醇

胆固醇（血液中的一种脂肪）积聚可能导致心脏病或中风。询问您的医疗保健团队您的胆固醇水平应该是多少。如果您超过 40 岁，您可能需要服用药物（例如他汀类药物）来降低胆固醇水平并保护您的心脏。一些低密度脂蛋白（“坏”）胆固醇非常高的人可能需要从年轻时开始服药。

了解如何检查胆固醇。

S是戒烟

戒烟对于糖尿病患者尤其重要，因为吸烟和糖尿病都会使血管收缩，因此您的心脏必须更加努力地工作。电子烟也不是一个安全的选择。

如果你戒烟

您将降低心脏病发作的风险；中风;神经、肾脏和眼部疾病；和截肢

也不是一个安全的选择。

如果你戒烟

您将降低心脏病发作的风险；中风;神经、肾脏和眼部疾病；和截肢

您的血糖、血压和胆固醇水平可能会改善

你的血液循环会改善

您可能会更容易进行身体活动

如果您吸烟或使用其他烟草制品，请停止。寻求帮助，这样您就不必独自完成。您可以首先拨打全国戒烟热线 1-800-QUITNOW 或 1-800-784-8669。有关戒烟的提示，请访问 Smokefree.gov 。

向您的医疗保健团队询问您的 A1C、血压和胆固醇目标，以及您可以采取哪些措施来实现这些目标。为了提高您的糖尿病自我管理技能，您可能需要转介给糖尿病教育者或注册营养师。医疗保险、一些私人保险公司和其他组织将为其中一些服务提供财务援助。

或注册营养师。医疗保险、一些私人保险公司和其他组织将为其中一些服务提供财务援助。

您可以使用糖尿病记录表来跟踪您的 ABC。您可以在亲自或远程与医疗保健团队会面时使用它。与您的团队讨论您的目标和进展情况，以及您是否需要对糖尿病护理计划进行任何更改。

养成或保持健康的生活习惯

坚持健康的生活习惯可以帮助您控制糖尿病和预防心脏病。

遵循您的健康饮食计划。

让体育活动成为您日常生活的一部分。

保持或达到健康体重。

保证充足的睡眠。

了解有关这些糖尿病管理技巧的更多信息。

观看有关如何保持心脏健康的视频。

了解体重计划表，它可以帮助您制定个人计划以达到目标体重。

学会管理压力

心脏健康。

了解体重计划表，它可以帮助您制定个人计划以达到目标体重。

学会管理压力

管理糖尿病并不总是那么容易。当您患有糖尿病时，感到压力、悲伤、孤独或愤怒是很常见的。您可能知道如何保持健康，但随着时间的推移可能很难坚持您的计划。长期压力会导致血糖和血压升高，但您可以学习减轻压力的方法。尝试深呼吸、园艺、散步、做瑜伽、与亲人交谈、培养一项爱好或听你最喜欢的音乐。了解更多有关应对压力的健康方法。

吃药保护你的心脏

药物可能是您治疗计划的重要组成部分。您的医生会根据您的具体需求开药。药物或许可以帮助你

满足您的 A1C（血糖）、血压和胆固醇目标。

降低血栓、心脏病或中风的风险。

可能会帮助你

满足您的 A1C（血糖）、血压和胆固醇目标。

降低血栓、心脏病或中风的风险。

治疗心绞痛或胸痛，这通常是心脏病的症状。心绞痛也可能是心脏病发作的早期症状。

治疗心力衰竭，这是一种心脏病，您的心脏无法充分泵血以使您的身体正常工作。

询问您的医生是否应该每天服用阿司匹林。阿司匹林并非对所有人都安全。您的医生可以告诉您服用阿司匹林是否适合您以及确切的服用量。

他汀类药物可以降低某些糖尿病患者心脏病发作或中风的风险。此外，某些糖尿病药物已被证明可以降低心脏病发作风险极高的患者的心脏病发作和死亡风险。与您的医生交谈，了解服用他汀类药物或降低心脏病发作风险的糖尿病药物是否适合您。

心脏病发作。与您的医生交谈，了解服用他汀类药物或降低心脏病发作风险的糖尿病药物是否适合您。

按照医生或医疗保健团队告诉您的方式服药。如果您对药物有疑问，请咨询您的医生或药剂师。在开始使用新药之前，请询问医生可能出现的副作用以及如何避免这些副作用。如果药物的副作用困扰您，请告诉您的医生。在未先咨询医生的情况下，请勿停止服药。

医生如何诊断糖尿病患者的心脏病？
